title: Kinetic and Thermodynamic Control of Macrocyclic Peptide Conformation through Late-Stage Chemical Modification
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract We describe the use of lactone ring-opening as a chemical tool for producing differentiated conformations of macrocyclic peptides. Under kinetic control, the lactone opening is highly atroposelective across macrocyclic precursors tested. Under thermodynamic control, reversible lactone opening equilibrates the atropisomers. A combined NMR/molecular dynamics study reveals that the atropisomers arising from lactone opening can adopt markedly different conformations, ranging from a 310-helix to various noncanonical conformations. In the RGD-containing macrocycle, the kinetic atropisomer recapitulates the 3D geometry involved in integrin binding, whereas the thermodynamic atropisomer adopts a distinct conformation that was not previously described. Together, these results establish a new strategy to control the conformational states of macrocyclic peptides.
title_zh: 通过后期化学修饰对大环肽构象进行动力学和热力学控制
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们描述了使用内酯开环作为生产大环肽差异构象的化学工具。在动力学控制下，内酯的开环对所测试的大环前体具有高度的选择性。在热力学控制下，可逆内酯打开平衡了阻转异构体。核磁共振/分子动力学联合研究表明，内酯开环产生的阻转异构体可以采用明显不同的构象，从 310 螺旋到各种非规范构象。在包含 RGD 的大环中，动力学阻转异构体概括了整合素结合所涉及的 3D 几何形状，而热力学阻转异构体采用了之前未描述过的独特构象。总之，这些结果建立了控制大环肽构象状态的新策略。

title: Non-Faradaic Promotion of Pd-Catalyzed Benzaldehyde Hydrogenation Induced by Cathodic Potential
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Pd-catalyzed hydrogenation of benzaldehyde to benzyl alcohol in the aqueous phase is significantly enhanced relative to open-circuit conditions when H2 pressure and an external cathodic potential are applied simultaneously. This dual-mode operation affords hydrogenation rates up to 6-fold higher than those observed under open-circuit conditions. The rate enhancement exceeds the expected charge-transfer contribution by at least a factor of 2 at all investigated potentials, indicating a non-Faradaic promotion effect. Combined experimental and theoretical analyses suggest that cathodic polarization increases the quasi-equilibrium surface coverage of a hydroxy intermediate formed via a proton-coupled electron transfer step preceding the rate-determining addition of the second hydrogen atom. At more negative potentials, where this coverage saturates, further rate acceleration likely arises from modulation of the standard free energies of intermediates and transition states along the rate-determining pathway, thereby lowering the apparent standard activation free energy.
title_zh: 阴极电位诱导 Pd 催化苯甲醛加氢的非法拉第促进
abstract_zh: 摘要 当同时施加氢气压力和外部阴极电位时，相对于开路条件，Pd 催化水相中苯甲醛加氢生成苯甲醇的反应显着增强。这种双模式操作的氢化速率比开路条件下观察到的氢化速率高出 6 倍。在所有研究的电位下，速率增强超过预期电荷转移贡献至少 2 倍，表明非法拉第促进效应。结合实验和理论分析表明，阴极极化增加了羟基中间体的准平衡表面覆盖度，该羟基中间体是通过在决定速率的第二个氢原子添加之前的质子耦合电子转移步骤形成的。在更负的电势下，当该覆盖范围饱和时，进一步的速率加速可能是由于沿速率决定路径调节中间体和过渡态的标准自由能而产生的，从而降低了表观标准活化自由能。

title: Proteoform-Resolved Cross-Linking Reveals Environment-Dependent Structural Effects of α-Synuclein S129 Phosphorylation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) drive many neurodegenerative disorders, but their structures remain difficult to define because they populate dynamic ensembles that change with the chemical environment. This problem is central for α-synuclein (aSyn), a Parkinson’s disease-linked IDP in which S129 phosphorylation is highly enriched in disease-associated aggregates. Although S129 phosphorylation stabilizes a more compact aSyn ensemble in dilute solution, whether this structural effect persists across other biochemical environments has remained unknown. Here, we developed a quantitative cross-linking mass spectrometry framework to determine how WT and pS129 aSyn respond to chemically distinct environments. We compared dilute buffer with two perturbations relevant to aSyn biology: trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO), a gut-microbiome-derived metabolite associated with Parkinson’s disease that can also act as a compacting osmolyte at high concentration, and octyl glucoside (OG) micelles, which provide a membrane-mimetic surface. TMAO rewired the phosphorylation-dependent structural response in a concentration-dependent manner: 1.8 M TMAO shifted WT aSyn toward the dilute pS129 contact pattern by increasing long-range contacts between the N-terminal and C-terminal regions, whereas 3.4 M TMAO collapsed both proteoforms and reduced their structural differences. In OG micelles, the proteoforms diverged. WT favored an extended-helix-like contact pattern with stronger contacts between the C-terminal tail and micelle-bound N-terminal region, whereas pS129 favored contacts between the N-terminal and NAC regions and fewer contacts to the C-terminal tail, consistent with a broken-helix-like topology. By integrating regional contact counts, normalized cross-link intensities, and geometric compatibility analysis, this workflow distinguishes broad contact accessibility from the residue-level contacts that dominate each condition. These results establish a proteoform-by-environment model for IDP structure, in which phosphorylation effects are not fixed but are rewritten by the surrounding chemical environment.
title_zh: 蛋白质形式解析的交联揭示了 α-突触核蛋白 S129 磷酸化的环境依赖性结构效应
abstract_zh: 摘要 本质无序蛋白 (IDP) 会导致许多神经退行性疾病，但它们的结构仍然难以定义，因为它们构成随化学环境而变化的动态整体。这个问题是 α-突触核蛋白 (aSyn) 的核心问题，α-突触核蛋白是一种与帕金森病相关的 IDP，其中 S129 磷酸化在与疾病相关的聚集体中高度富集。尽管 S129 磷酸化在稀溶液中稳定了更紧凑的 aSyn 整体，但这种结构效应是否在其他生化环境中持续存在仍然未知。在这里，我们开发了定量交联质谱框架，以确定 WT 和 pS129 aSyn 如何响应化学上不同的环境。我们将稀释缓冲液与与 aSyn 生物学相关的两种扰动进行了比较：三甲胺 N-氧化物 (TMAO)，一种与帕金森病相关的肠道微生物组衍生的代谢物，在高浓度下也可以充当压实渗透剂，以及辛基葡萄糖苷 (OG) 胶束，它提供了膜模拟表面。 TMAO 以浓度依赖性方式重新连接磷酸化依赖性结构反应：1.8 M TMAO 通过增加 N 端和 C 端区域之间的长距离接触，将 WT aSyn 转向稀释的 pS129 接触模式，而 3.4 M TMAO 则破坏了两种蛋白质形式并减少了它们的结构差异。在 OG 胶束中，蛋白质形式出现了分歧。 WT 倾向于延伸螺旋状接触模式，C 端尾部和胶束结合的 N 端区域之间具有更强的接触，而 pS129 则倾向于 b 接触。

title: Rapid, Low-Cost, Low-Temperature Pyrazole-Flux Synthesis of Imide Covalent Organic Frameworks for Uranium/Rare Earth Separation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract High-crystalline imide covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are highly desirable owing to their outstanding robust nature; however, their practical applications are hindered by the rigorous synthesis conditions, such as the use of massive toxic solvents, high reaction temperature, and long reaction time. Therefore, there is an increasing effort to develop mild synthesis conditions. We report herein a general and convenient pyrazole-flux synthesis that can lead to gram-level production of highly crystalline imide COFs in a mild manner with a short reaction time (5 h) and low reaction temperature (120 °C) in the absence of any organic solvent, including both synthesis and purification processes. Notably, pyrazole-flux should be the cheapest and mildest among all established organic fluxes, and water can be used to purify the resultant samples in this pyrazole-flux synthesis, rather than using an organic solvent in the established organic-flux methods. Through this pyrazole-flux synthesis, four imide COFs are obtained from the assembly of pyromellitic dianhydride with two types of amine monomers in triangular and tetragonal configurations, confirming the generality of this method. The mechanism involves pyrazole as a nucleophilic catalyst for activating anhydride and then promoting the amidation reaction. As a proof-of-concept application, one imide COF is found to show promising potential for uranium/rare earth separation and selective extraction of uranium from rare earth slag.
title_zh: 用于铀/稀土分离的酰亚胺共价有机框架的快速、低成本、低温吡唑助熔剂合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 高结晶酰亚胺共价有机框架（COF）因其出色的坚固性而备受关注。然而，其实际应用受到严格的合成条件的阻碍，例如使用大量有毒溶剂、高反应温度和长反应时间。因此，人们越来越努力开发温和的合成条件。我们在此报道了一种通用且方便的吡唑助熔剂合成方法，可以在不存在任何有机溶剂的情况下，以温和的方式、短的反应时间（5小时）和低的反应温度（120°C），导致克级生产高度结晶的酰亚胺COF，包括合成和纯化过程。值得注意的是，吡唑助焊剂应该是所有已建立的有机助焊剂中最便宜和最温和的，并且在该吡唑助焊剂合成中可以使用水来纯化所得样品，而不是在已建立的有机助焊剂方法中使用有机溶剂。通过这种吡唑助熔剂的合成，由均苯四酸二酐与三角形和四方构型的两种胺单体组装得到四种酰亚胺COF，证实了该方法的通用性。其机理涉及吡唑作为亲核催化剂激活酸酐，然后促进酰胺化反应。作为一种概念验证应用，一种酰亚胺COF被发现在铀/稀土分离和从稀土渣中选择性提取铀方面表现出良好的潜力。

title: Self-Sustained Hydrogen Relay Enables Thermodynamically Coupled Cyclohexane-CO2 Conversion to Aromatics over Tandem Catalysts
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Naphthenes constitute major components of naphtha, yet their conversion to aromatics via dehydrogenation remains thermodynamically constrained and energy-intensive. Here we report a thermodynamically coupled strategy that integrates endothermic cyclohexane dehydrogenation with exothermic CO2 hydrogenation, enabling thermodynamically compensated aromatization under mild conditions. Using a tandem Pd@S-1 and ZnZrOx/ZSM-5 catalyst, cyclohexane dehydrogenation, CO2 activation, and methanol-mediated alkylation are synergistically coupled within a hydrogen-shuttling network. Under continuous-flow conditions (370 °C, 3 MPa), the system achieves 99% cyclohexane conversion and 99% aromatics selectivity with 38% CO2 conversion. Operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) reveals dynamic Pd0/PdO interconversion, while Zn–O–Zr sites remain structurally stable to facilitate CO2 activation. 13CO2 isotopic tracing confirms direct incorporation of CO2-derived carbon into aromatic products. This work establishes a hydrogen shuttle-enabled thermochemical paradigm for coupling endothermic and exothermic reactions, offering an energy-efficient route for naphthene upgrading and CO2 valorization.
title_zh: 自持氢继电器能够通过串联催化剂将环己烷-CO2 热力学耦合转化为芳烃
abstract_zh: 摘要 环烷烃是石脑油的主要成分，但它们通过脱氢转化为芳烃的过程仍然受到热力学限制并且是能源密集型的。在这里，我们报告了一种热力学耦合策略，该策略将吸热环己烷脱氢与放热二氧化碳氢化相结合，从而在温和条件下实现热力学补偿芳构化。使用串联 Pd@S-1 和 ZnZrOx/ZSM-5 催化剂，环己烷脱氢、CO2 活化和甲醇介导的烷基化在氢穿梭网络内协同耦合。在连续流动条件下（370℃，3MPa），该系统实现了99%的环己烷转化率和99%的芳烃选择性，以及38%的CO2转化率。 Operando X射线吸收光谱（XAS）揭示了动态的Pd0/PdO相互转化，而Zn-O-Zr位点保持结构稳定以促进CO2活化。 13CO2 同位素示踪证实了源自 CO2 的碳直接掺入芳香族产品中。这项工作建立了一种氢穿梭热化学范例，用于耦合吸热和放热反应，为环烷烃升级和二氧化碳增值提供了一条节能途径。

title: Proton Relaying in Carbenium-Based Oxygen Reduction
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The catalytic reduction of oxygen is at the heart of many energy-related and biological processes. Traditionally mediated by transition metals, metal-free systems have emerged as a powerful alternative. In this study, we describe newly prepared quinoline-carbenium species as catalysts for the two-electron reduction of oxygen and show that the quinoline nitrogen atom, depending on its position, can act as a proton relay, thereby boosting the H2O2 production rate. Kinetic studies, H/D kinetic isotope effect measurements, and cyclic voltammetric investigations support a mechanism that involves intramolecular proton transfer from the protonated quinoline moiety to a carbenium hydroperoxide intermediate in the rate-determining step. Additional kinetic investigations indicate that, in contrast to the proton relaying system, simple carbenium ions use acid from the bulk of the solution to heterolytically cleave the C–O bond of the key carbenium hydroperoxide intermediate. Finally, we uncover the effect of the proton relay on the overpotential, affording an ηeff as low as 80 mV.
title_zh: 碳基氧还原中的质子传递
abstract_zh: 摘要 氧的催化还原是许多能源相关和生物过程的核心。传统上由过渡金属介导的无金属系统已成为一种强大的替代方案。在这项研究中，我们描述了新制备的喹啉碳物种作为氧双电子还原的催化剂，并表明喹啉氮原子根据其位置可以充当质子中继，从而提高 H2O2 的产率。动力学研究、H/D 动力学同位素效应测量和循环伏安研究支持了一种机制，该机制涉及在速率决定步骤中从质子化喹啉部分到氢过氧化碳中间体的分子内质子转移。其他动力学研究表明，与质子中继系统相比，简单的碳正离子使用溶液中的酸来异解裂解关键碳正氢过氧化物中间体的 C-O 键。最后，我们揭示了质子继电器对超电势的影响，使 ηeff 低至 80 mV。

title: Rethinking concrete durability for low-carbon concretes through climate-informed corrosion modelling
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Decarbonizing concrete is essential for meeting global climate targets. Many effective strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions result in lower concrete alkalinity, which has traditionally been viewed as a durability concern, namely promoting steel corrosion in concrete. This prevailing durability paradigm – firmly embedded in engineering mindsets and industry standards – hinders the practical implementation and thus the realization of the full potential of low-carbon concretes. To resolve this situation, we propose a conceptual framework that offers a perspective on ensuring the durability of reinforced concrete, while tolerating reduced concrete alkalinity. Our approach is inspired by empirical observations and recent scientific insights that consistently pinpointed the decisive role of moisture in concrete durability. We leverage advancements in moisture transport modeling in porous media and corrosion science to predict the time-evolution of the microclimate and corrosion kinetics at the steel-concrete interface. By drawing on time-resolved meteorological data from four examples in Europe, Asia and South America, we showcase the approach, underlining the critical role of local climate for predicting the durability performance of concrete. This work establishes the basis for developing test methods, standards, and predictive tools to promote eco-friendly concrete and evaluate how climate change impacts their durability for generations to come.
title_zh: 通过气候知情的腐蚀模型重新思考低碳混凝土的耐久性
abstract_zh: 混凝土脱碳对于实现全球气候目标至关重要。许多减少温室气体排放的有效策略会导致混凝土碱度降低，传统上这被视为耐久性问题，即促进混凝土中的钢材腐蚀。这种普遍存在的耐久性范式——牢固地嵌入工程思维和行业标准中——阻碍了低碳混凝土的实际实施，从而阻碍了其全部潜力的实现。为了解决这种情况，我们提出了一个概念框架，该框架提供了确保钢筋混凝土的耐久性，同时容忍混凝土碱度降低的观点。我们的方法受到经验观察和最新科学见解的启发，这些见解始终指出水分在混凝土耐久性中的决定性作用。我们利用多孔介质和腐蚀科学中水分传输模型的进步来预测钢-混凝土界面处微气候和腐蚀动力学的时间演变。通过利用来自欧洲、亚洲和南美洲四个例子的时间分辨气象数据，我们展示了该方法，强调了当地气候在预测混凝土耐久性能方面的关键作用。这项工作为开发测试方法、标准和预测工具奠定了基础，以推广生态友好型混凝土并评估气候变化如何影响其子孙后代的耐久性。

title: Migration-Coupled Local Fluoride Relaxation in Li2– x La(1+ x )/3Nb2O6F Single Crystals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract High Li–ion conductivity is difficult to achieve in chemically robust solid electrolytes, especially oxides and oxyfluorides, because their rigid, less polarizable anion frameworks generally give rise to high migration barriers. The pyrochlore-type oxyfluoride Li2–xLa(1+x)/3Nb2O6F (LLNOF) is an unusual example that combines high bulk Li–ion conductivity with a low activation energy, but the origin of this behavior has remained unclear, largely because no single-crystal study has been available. Here we report the first growth of millimeter-sized LLNOF single crystals and establish nearly isotropic bulk Li–ion conduction. The bulk Li–ion conductivity increases with decreasing x, reaching 16.3 mS cm–1 at 25 °C, while the activation energy decreases systematically. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction and maximum entropy method analyses reveal that the cubic pyrochlore framework is retained, while the electron-density distribution around the F site contains a directional off-centered component toward neighboring 16d sites. This component is resolved as a density maximum at 150 K and remains as a shoulder at the same displacement at room temperature, indicating that the local off-centered component persists but is thermally averaged. Together, these observations support a local rearrangement of the fluoride environment coupled to Li/vacancy exchange. They identify migration-coupled local fluoride relaxation as a viable mechanism for low-barrier Li–ion transport in chemically robust solids lacking highly polarizable anion frameworks.
title_zh: Li2– x La(1+ x )/3Nb2O6F 单晶中迁移耦合的局部氟化物弛豫
abstract_zh: 摘要 在化学性质稳定的固体电解质中，特别是氧化物和氟氧化物，很难实现高锂离子电导率，因为它们刚性的、不易极化的阴离子框架通常会产生高迁移势垒。烧绿石型氟氧化物Li2–xLa(1+x)/3Nb2O6F (LLNOF)是一个不寻常的例子，它结合了高体积锂离子电导率和低活化能，但这种行为的起源仍不清楚，很大程度上是因为还没有单晶研究。在这里，我们报告了毫米级 LLNOF 单晶的首次生长，并建立了近各向同性的块状锂离子传导。体积锂离子电导率随着 x 的减小而增加，在 25 °C 时达到 16.3 mS cm-1，而活化能系统地降低。单晶X射线衍射和最大熵法分析表明，立方烧绿石骨架得以保留，而F位点周围的电子密度分布包含朝向邻近16d位点的定向偏心分量。该分量在 150 K 时解析为密度最大值，并在室温下以相同位移保留为肩部，表明局部偏心分量仍然存在，但已热平均。总之，这些观察结果支持氟化物环境的局部重排与锂/空位交换相结合。他们认为迁移耦合的局部氟化物弛豫是在缺乏高度极化阴离子框架的化学稳定固体中低势垒锂离子传输的可行机制。

title: Bridge health monitoring using existing telecommunication fiber-optic networks
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Aging bridges pose significant risks to public safety. Although existing sensing technologies offer a potential solution for structural health monitoring, the high cost and complexity of installing and maintaining sensing systems have limited their scalability and long-term deployment. Here, we present a scalable and cost-effective approach that turns pre-existing telecommunication (telecom) fiber-optic cables into a dense array of dynamic strain sensors to continuously monitor bridges. Using telecom fibers, we retrieve guided wavefields across bridge superstructures, which was impossible with existing sensing technologies due to their limited scalability and the prohibitive cost of ultra-dense sensor arrays required to capture meter-scale wavelengths. We also estimate quasi-static displacements with millimeter-level accuracy and extract modal parameters. These results demonstrate that our approach is robust to noise from imperfect fiber-bridge coupling, a limitation inherent to the non-dedicated nature of telecom fibers used as sensors. Furthermore, we demonstrated the effectiveness of this approach through field evaluations across six bridges in the United States and South Korea. Because telecom fibers are widely deployed and co-located with civil infrastructure systems, this study introduces a new sensing paradigm that leverages existing fiber-optic networks to enable large-scale, real-time structural monitoring without the cost and logistical burden of dedicated sensors.
title_zh: 使用现有电信光纤网络进行桥梁健康监测
abstract_zh: 老化的桥梁对公共安全构成重大风险。尽管现有的传感技术为结构健康监测提供了潜在的解决方案，但安装和维护传感系统的高成本和复杂性限制了其可扩展性和长期部署。在这里，我们提出了一种可扩展且经济高效的方法，将现有的电信（电信）光纤电缆转变为密集的动态应变传感器阵列，以连续监测桥梁。使用电信光纤，我们可以检索跨桥梁上部结构的引导波场，这对于现有的传感技术来说是不可能的，因为它们的可扩展性有限，而且捕获米级波长所需的超密集传感器阵列的成本过高。我们还以毫米级精度估计准静态位移并提取模态参数。这些结果表明，我们的方法对于不完美的光纤桥耦合产生的噪声具有鲁棒性，这是用作传感器的电信光纤的非专用性质所固有的限制。此外，我们通过对美国和韩国六座桥梁的现场评估证明了这种方法的有效性。由于电信光纤被广泛部署并与民用基础设施系统共置一地，因此本研究引入了一种新的传感范例，该范例利用现有光纤网络来实现大规模实时结构监测，而无需专用传感器的成本和后勤负担。

title: Fluorescence resonance energy transfer between isomers of molecular photoswitches
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Photocontrollable luminescent molecular photoswitches are pivotal for stimuli-responsive smart materials, yet balancing fluorescence with photoswitching performance and enabling isomerization in solid matrices remain challenging. Herein, we design and synthesize a series of fluorescent donor-acceptor Stenhouse adducts (DASAs) and introduce a strategy utilizing fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) between photoswitch isomers to achieve robust, contactless, and dynamic fluorescence modulation. The resulting DASAs exhibit remarkable photoswitching efficiency and high fluorescence quantum yields. Furthermore, they are successfully incorporated into shape-memory polymer films, which not only facilitate efficient and stable isomerization in the solid state but also enable rapid recovery and reusability. These advantages are leveraged to demonstrate applications in cold-chain transport labeling and multi-level information encryption. This work paves the way for the future design of DASAs and establishes FRET between photoswitch isomers as a powerful concept for developing next-generation photoswitches.
title_zh: 分子光开关异构体之间的荧光共振能量转移
abstract_zh: 光控发光分子光开关对于刺激响应智能材料至关重要，但平衡荧光与光开关性能以及在固体基质中实现异构化仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们设计并合成了一系列荧光供体-受体斯滕豪斯加合物（DASA），并引入了利用光开关异构体之间的荧光共振能量转移（FRET）的策略，以实现稳健、非接触式和动态荧光调制。由此产生的 DASA 表现出卓越的光开关效率和高荧光量子产率。此外，它们被成功地融入形状记忆聚合物薄膜中，不仅促进了固态下高效稳定的异构化，而且能够实现快速恢复和可重复使用。利用这些优势来演示在冷链运输标签和多级信息加密中的应用。这项工作为 DASA 的未来设计铺平了道路，并将光电开关异构体之间的 FRET 建立为开发下一代光电开关的强大概念。

title: Visible light–triggered co-upcycling of polypropylene and polyethylene terephthalate using waste chlorinated solvents
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The chemical incompatibility of mixed plastics poses a fundamental barrier to their circularity. Polypropylene (PP) and polyethylene terephthalate (PET), among the highest-volume manufactured polyolefin and polyester, are particularly difficult to process together due to their divergent structures and stabilities. Here, we demonstrate a synergistic photo-induced strategy that concurrently converts both polymers into valuable products by employing waste chlorinated solvents as a sustainable chlorine radical source. Under visible-light irradiation, chlorine radicals generated in situ from these discarded solvents selectively abstract tertiary hydrogens from PP, triggering an oxygen-mediated chain scission that produces terminal methyl ketone-functionalized polypropylene with lower-molecular-weight (OPP)—a material exhibiting strong performance as a hot-melt adhesive. The hydrogen chloride released during this process simultaneously drives efficient PET depolymerization into terephthalic acid with 1,2-dichloroethane. This coupled reaction not only enables compatible valorization of mixed plastic waste but also upgrades hazardous chlorinated solvents into functional reagents, establishing a triple-waste valorization paradigm with potential for further scale-up and process optimization for sustainable materials management.
title_zh: 使用废弃氯化溶剂进行可见光触发的聚丙烯和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯的联合升级回收
abstract_zh: 混合塑料的化学不相容性对其循环性构成了根本障碍。聚丙烯 (PP) 和聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯 (PET) 属于产量最高的聚烯烃和聚酯，由于结构和稳定性不同，因此很难一起加工。在这里，我们展示了一种协同光诱导策略，通过利用废弃氯化溶剂作为可持续的氯自由基源，同时将两种聚合物转化为有价值的产品。在可见光照射下，这些废弃溶剂原位产生的氯自由基选择性地从 PP 中提取叔氢，引发氧介导的断链，产生末端甲基酮功能化的低分子量聚丙烯 (OPP)，这种材料具有很强的热熔粘合剂性能。在此过程中释放的氯化氢同时驱动 PET 与 1,2-二氯乙烷有效解聚成对苯二甲酸。这种耦合反应不仅能够实现混合塑料废物的兼容增值，而且还将危险的氯化溶剂升级为功能性试剂，建立了三重废物增值范例，具有进一步扩大规模和流程优化可持续材料管理的潜力。

title: An ab initio foundation model of wavefunctions that accurately describes chemical bond breaking
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Reliable description of bond breaking remains a major challenge for quantum chemistry due to the multireference character of the electronic structure in dissociating species. Multireference methods in particular suffer from large computational cost, which under the normal paradigm has to be paid anew for each system at a full price, ignoring commonalities in electronic structure across molecules. Quantum Monte Carlo with deep neural networks uniquely offers to exploit such commonalities by pretraining transferable wavefunction models, but all such attempts were so far limited in scope. Here, we bring this paradigm to fruition with Orbformer, a transferable wavefunction model pretrained on 22,000 equilibrium and dissociating structures that can be fine-tuned on unseen molecules reaching an accuracy–cost ratio rivalling classical multireference methods. On established benchmarks as well as more challenging bond dissociations and Diels–Alder reactions, Orbformer is the only method that consistently converges to chemical accuracy (1 kcal/mol). This work turns the idea of amortizing the cost of solving the Schrödinger equation over many molecules into a practical approach in quantum chemistry.
title_zh: 准确描述化学键断裂的波函数从头算基础模型
abstract_zh: 由于解离物质中电子结构的多参考特征，对键断裂的可靠描述仍然是量子化学的主要挑战。多参考方法尤其遭受巨大的计算成本，在正常范式下必须以全价为每个系统重新支付计算成本，忽略了跨分子电子结构的共性。具有深度神经网络的量子蒙特卡罗独特地提供了通过预训练可转移波函数模型来利用这些共性，但迄今为止所有这些尝试都仅限于范围。在这里，我们通过 Orbformer 实现了这一范例，这是一种可转移波函数模型，在 22,000 个平衡和解离结构上进行了预训练，可以对看不见的分子进行微调，达到与经典多参考方法相媲美的精度成本比。在既定基准以及更具挑战性的键解离和 Diels-Alder 反应中，Orbformer 是唯一始终收敛于化学精度 (1 kcal/mol) 的方法。这项工作将在许多分子上分摊求解薛定谔方程的成本的想法转变为量子化学中的实用方法。

title: Charge-carrier enrichment type-dependent product selectivity in methane photooxidation
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Selective photocatalytic oxidation of methane to value-added C1 oxygenates under mild conditions is attractive but remains limited by poor control over branching selectivity, because methanol and formaldehyde share closely related energetics and pathways. Here we demonstrate programmable selectivity in methane photooxidation by steering the dominant type of photogenerated charge carriers at metal/boron nitride (BN) interfaces. Carrier enrichment at the active sites dictates the hydrogen-transfer steps that govern the fate of a common hydroxymethyl intermediate, enabling selective switching between methanol and formaldehyde. We propose that electron-enriched AuNPs/BN facilitates hydroxymethyl intermediate hydrogenation to methanol, whereas hole-accumulating PdSA/BN promotes hydroxymethyl intermediate dehydrogenation to formaldehyde. Under atmospheric pressure, PdSA/BN gives formaldehyde with ~90% selectivity and generation rate of 1653.75 μmol·g−1·h−1, while AuNPs/BN achieves ~92% selective methanol production at 1070.17 μmol·g−1·h−1. Here, we show that establishing carrier-polarity programming at heterogeneous interfaces as a general strategy to control branching selectivity in photocatalytic C-H oxidation.
title_zh: 甲烷光氧化中载流子富集类型依赖的产物选择性
abstract_zh: 在温和条件下将甲烷选择性光催化氧化为增值的 C1 含氧化合物很有吸引力，但由于甲醇和甲醛具有密切相关的能量和途径，因此对支化选择性的控制不佳仍然受到限制。在这里，我们通过控制金属/氮化硼（BN）界面上光生载流子的主要类型来展示甲烷光氧化的可编程选择性。活性位点的载流子富集决定了控制常见羟甲基中间体命运的氢转移步骤，从而实现甲醇和甲醛之间的选择性切换。我们提出，富电子的 AuNPs/BN 促进羟甲基中间体加氢生成甲醇，而空穴积累的 PdSA/BN 促进羟甲基中间体脱氢生成甲醛。在大气压下，PdSA/BN以约90%的选择性产生甲醛，生成率为1653.75 μmol·g−1·h−1，而AuNPs/BN以1070.17 μmol·g−1·h−1实现约92%的选择性甲醇生成。在这里，我们展示了在异质界面建立载流子极性编程作为控制光催化 C-H 氧化中支化选择性的一般策略。

title: Vorticity-induced short-range ordering for heat insulation in anisotropically bonded CsAg2I3
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Vortical motion naturally occurs on various scales, from galaxies to skyrmions, influencing the dynamics of mass and information transport. Yet its impact on lattice dynamics in solids is rarely explored so far, primarily owing to the strong interatomic bonds in real materials that inhibit the actual transport of their constituent species. Here we investigate the effect of vortical modes of polarized phonons on the heat insulation of solid materials using synchrotron X-ray diffuse scattering and inelastic neutron scattering along with ab initio molecular dynamics simulations. We demonstrate this vortical vibration as well as its effect on thermal insulation in CsAg2I3, where the anisotropically bonded iodine atoms form the low-lying transverse optical phonons for enhancing scattering phase space. Moreover, the vortical modes, mainly arising from the chiral symmetric operations acting on the iodine sites, induce two-dimensional short-range-ordering of atomic clusters, lead to a substantially increased phonon scattering centers with a diameter on the order of ~2 primitive cells. This eventually results in extraordinary heat insulation in the single-crystalline CsAg2I3, exhibiting a thermal conductivity as low as 0.08 W/m-K at room temperature. This strategy establishes a material design paradigm for heat insulation and unveils an unexplored avenue for phonon transport manipulation.
title_zh: 各向异性键合 CsAg2I3 中隔热的涡量引起的短程有序
abstract_zh: 涡旋运动自然发生在从星系到斯格明子的各种尺度上，影响质量和信息传输的动力学。然而，迄今为止，它对固体晶格动力学的影响很少被探讨，这主要是由于真实材料中强大的原子间键抑制了其组成物质的实际传输。在这里，我们利用同步加速器 X 射线漫散射和非弹性中子散射以及从头算分子动力学模拟来研究偏振声子涡旋模式对固体材料隔热的影响。我们证明了这种涡旋振动及其对 CsAg2I3 隔热的影响，其中各向异性键合的碘原子形成低位横向光学声子，以增强散射相空间。此外，主要由作用于碘位点的手性对称操作产生的涡旋模式引起原子团簇的二维短程排序，导致声子散射中心显着增加，其直径约为2个原始细胞的数量级。这最终导致单晶 CsAg2I3 具有非凡的隔热性能，在室温下表现出低至 0.08 W/m-K 的导热率。该策略建立了隔热材料设计范例，并为声子传输操纵开辟了一条未经探索的途径。

title: What is the problem and what can be done when data sharing challenges public legitimacy?
source: Scientific community and society : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Surveys suggest that health data sharing with industry and across national borders challenges public legitimacy. We argue that this resistance reflects deeper concerns about profit motives and loss of control and provide guidance on responsive governance to ensure public trust.
title_zh: 当数据共享挑战公共合法性时，问题是什么以及可以做什么？
abstract_zh: 调查表明，与行业和跨国界共享健康数据挑战了公共合法性。我们认为，这种抵制反映了对利润动机和失去控制的更深层次的担忧，并为响应式治理提供了指导，以确保公众信任。

title: Geometry-Dependent Electronic Structure for Enhanced Ammonia Synthesis: From Nanoparticle to Nanosheet and Metallene
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Developing highly effective catalysts for ammonia (NH3) synthesis under mild conditions remains a challenging task. The active metals employed in catalysts are predominantly presented as zero-dimensional nanoparticles, which limits their capacity to fully exploit atoms and electrons, resulting in unsatisfactory activity. Herein, we present triangular Ru nanosheet that features a two-dimensional structure characterized by a hexagonal close-packed atomic arrangement. The thickness of the Ru nanosheet is further tailored down to angstrom level, yielding Ru metallene. In contrast to Ru nanoparticles or regular nanosheet, our studies demonstrate that the unique geometric configuration of Ru metallene substantially stabilizes metallic Ru0 active sites enriched with abundant 4d electrons. Therefore, atomically thin Ru metallene delivers a high NH3 synthesis rate of 70.7 mmol gcat–1 h–1 at 400 °C and 1 MPa, surpassing Ru nanoparticles or nanosheets. This synthetic approach is broadly applicable to other transition metals (e.g., Fe and Mo). This work provides a new route for angstrom-level geometric engineering for NH3 synthesis catalysts.
title_zh: 用于增强氨合成的几何依赖电子结构：从纳米颗粒到纳米片和金属烯
abstract_zh: 摘要 开发在温和条件下合成氨（NH3）的高效催化剂仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。催化剂中使用的活性金属主要以零维纳米粒子的形式存在，这限制了它们充分利用原子和电子的能力，导致活性不理想。在此，我们提出了三角形钌纳米片，其特征在于六边形密堆积原子排列的二维结构。将 Ru 纳米片的厚度进一步调整至埃级，产生 Ru 金属烯。与 Ru 纳米粒子或常规纳米片相比，我们的研究表明，Ru 金属烯的独特几何构型基本上稳定了富含丰富 4d 电子的金属 Ru0 活性位点。因此，原子级薄的 Ru 金属烯在 400 °C 和 1 MPa 下具有 70.7 mmol gcat–1 h–1 的高 NH3 合成速率，超过了 Ru 纳米颗粒或纳米片。这种合成方法广泛适用于其他过渡金属（例如铁和钼）。该工作为NH3合成催化剂的埃级几何工程提供了一条新途径。

title: Delivering building demand flexibility for grid-interactive operation: from perception and cognition to decision, execution, and verification
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: As both buildings and power systems undergo rapid decarbonization, demand flexibility (DF) in buildings has emerged as a key enabler for renewable energy integration, grid reliability, energy resilience, and efficient and low carbon operation. By dynamically adjusting building energy use in response to grid requirements, DF can help reduce building operational costs, respond to renewable variability, reduce peak demand, alleviate network congestion, and enhance overall system stability. Consequently, significant research efforts have examined building DF from multiple perspectives, including flexibility definitions, resources, characterization, assessment, optimization, and application scenarios. However, the effective delivery of DF in buildings requires an integrated, end-to-end approach spanning perception, cognition, decision, execution, and verification, which remains a critical gap in the existing literature. This review addresses this gap by proposing a layered architecture that integrates these stages into a coherent framework and provides insights from existing studies in this field. It synthesizes enabling methods, clarifies cross-layer interactions, and examines how data, models, control strategies, implementation mechanisms, and evaluation approaches collectively support DF delivery. Critical cross-layer challenges are identified, and future research priorities for robust and trustworthy DF delivery are outlined. This work establishes a conceptual foundation for advancing interoperable, grid-responsive, and practically deployable DF solutions in buildings, supporting both building decarbonization and more efficient, resilient grid operation
title_zh: 为网格交互操作提供建筑需求灵活性：从感知和认知到决策、执行和验证
abstract_zh: 随着建筑和电力系统快速脱碳，建筑的需求灵活性（DF）已成为可再生能源整合、电网可靠性、能源弹性以及高效低碳运营的关键推动因素。通过根据电网要求动态调整建筑能源使用，DF 可以帮助降低建筑运营成本、应对可再生能源的变化、减少峰值需求、缓解网络拥塞并增强整体系统稳定性。因此，大量的研究工作从多个角度审视了构建 DF，包括灵活性定义、资源、表征、评估、优化和应用场景。然而，在建筑物中有效交付 DF 需要一种涵盖感知、认知、决策、执行和验证的集成的端到端方法，这仍然是现有文献中的一个关键差距。本综述通过提出一种分层架构来解决这一差距，该架构将这些阶段集成到一个连贯的框架中，并提供了该领域现有研究的见解。它综合了支持方法，阐明了跨层交互，并检查了数据、模型、控制策略、实施机制和评估方法如何共同支持 DF 交付。确定了关键的跨层挑战，并概述了稳健且值得信赖的 DF 交付的未来研究重点。这项工作为在建筑物中推进可互操作、网格响应和实际可部署的 DF 解决方案奠定了概念基础，支持

title: 1,3-Diene principle: an alternative pathway for allene deracemization transformation and migratory functionalization
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Asymmetric hydrofunctionalization of allenes has emerged as a valuable strategy for synthesizing privileged allyl skeletons. However, existing studies are largely restricted to special terminal allene substrates to avoid formidable deracemization issues. Herein, we present 1,3-diene principle as a new and broadly applicable mechanistic pathway to address this long-standing challenge and beyond. The 1,3-diene principle is demonstrated by the applications to over ten types of unexplored enantioselective transformations of racemic allenes. Stereodivergent synthesis, convergent preparation, and concise access to natural products further highlight the practical value and generality of this paradigm. Remarkably, the 1,3-diene manifold also enables the first allene migratory hydrofunctionalization, breaking the metal walking chemistry limited to alkene substrates. Both experimental results and theoretical calculations support the deracemization route involving 1,3-diene species, opening a new model for allene transformations.
title_zh: 1,3-二烯原理：丙二烯去消旋化转化和迁移功能化的替代途径
abstract_zh: 丙二烯的不对称氢官能化已成为合成特殊烯丙基骨架的有价值的策略。然而，现有的研究很大程度上局限于特殊的末端丙二烯底物，以避免严重的去消旋化问题。在此，我们提出 1,3-二烯原理作为一种新的且广泛适用的机制途径来解决这一长期存在的挑战及其他挑战。 1,3-二烯原理通过十多种未探索的外消旋丙二烯对映选择性转化的应用得到证明。立体发散合成、聚合制备和天然产物的简洁获取进一步凸显了该范式的实用价值和通用性。值得注意的是，1,3-二烯歧管还实现了第一个丙二烯迁移氢官能化，打破了仅限于烯烃基材的金属行走化学。实验结果和理论计算都支持涉及1,3-二烯物种的去消旋化路线，为丙二烯转化开辟了新模型。

title: Navigating regional zero-carbon steel pathways in China by aligning spatial resource constraints with facility heterogeneity
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: China’s iron and steel sector is pivotal to global industrial decarbonization, yet near-zero transition pathways under heterogeneous regional resource endowments remain poorly understood. Here we develop a plant-resolved, spatially explicit framework that integrates a facility-level emission database, a cost-minimizing technology model and geospatial resource matching. We find that blast furnace-basic oxygen furnace production accounts for 83% of sectoral emissions, while 35% of blast furnaces are 10–15 years old, creating retrofit opportunities and carbon lock-in risks. Achieving a 97% emissions reduction by 2060 requires accelerated retrofits before 2040, retirement of 140 small facilities, expansion of hydrogen metallurgy to 34.6%, and a limited role for carbon capture and storage at 12.1%. Relative to business as usual, the near-zero pathway cuts cumulative system costs by 2,184 billion United States dollars (USD) by 2060 despite USD 436 billion in stranded assets. Northern and coastal regions favour hydrogen metallurgy, whereas inland provinces concentrate 46% of national carbon capture capacity. This study highlights differentiated regional pathway for decarbonizing hard-to-abate sectors under technological lock-in and uneven resource endowments.
title_zh: 通过调整空间资源约束与设施异质性，探索中国区域零碳钢路径
abstract_zh: 中国钢铁行业对于全球工业脱碳至关重要，但在异质的区域资源禀赋下，近零转型路径仍知之甚少。在这里，我们开发了一个工厂解决的、空间明确的框架，该框架集成了设施级排放数据库、成本最小化技术模型和地理空间资源匹配。我们发现，高炉-碱性氧气转炉生产占行业排放量的 83%，而 35% 的高炉已有 10-15 年的使用年限，创造了改造机会和碳锁定风险。到2060年实现减排97%需要在2040年之前加速改造，淘汰140个小型设施，将氢冶金扩大到34.6%，并将碳捕获和封存的作用限制在12.1%。相对于一切照旧，到 2060 年，尽管有 4,360 亿美元的搁浅资产，但接近于零的路径将累计系统成本削减 21,840 亿美元 (USD)。北方和沿海地区青睐氢冶金，而内陆省份则集中了全国46%的碳捕集能力。本研究强调了在技术锁定和资源禀赋不均的情况下，难以减排行业脱碳的差异化区域路径。

title: Susceptibility of calves fed unpasteurized milk from cows infected with highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 was confirmed in a dairy cows in Texas March 2024 and milk was identified as a critical source of virus spread within and between dairy herds. This study demonstrates that calves fed infected unpasteurized milk from infected cows became infected, showed clinical signs including nasal discharge and increased respiratory effort, and seroconverted. Live virus was persistently detected in nasal swabs, even after calves were transitioned to milk from non-infected cows. This study also demonstrates the presence of neutralizing antibodies in milk provides from protection from infection as an additional group of calves fed milk from infected cows also shedding neutralizing antibodies did not become infected, show clinical signs, or seroconvert. These data demonstrate that milk diverted from the human food supply in H5N1 positive dairy herds or suspect cows should not be fed to calves without pasteurization, as H5N1 may further adapt to the bovine respiratory tract and the risk of calves as a source of farm to farm transmission has not yet been evaluated. As characterization of HPAI in the dairy community continues the determination of routes of transmission is an essential step to inform subsequent research on intervention and vaccination strategies.
title_zh: 饲喂感染高致病性禽流感 H5N1 的奶牛未经高温消毒的牛奶的犊牛的易感性
abstract_zh: 2024 年 3 月，在德克萨斯州的一头奶牛中确认了高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1，牛奶被确定为奶牛群内部和奶牛群之间病毒传播的关键来源。这项研究表明，饲喂来自受感染奶牛的未经高温消毒的受感染牛奶的小牛受到感染，表现出包括鼻分泌物和呼吸困难增加在内的临床症状，并发生血清转化。即使在小牛转产未受感染奶牛的牛奶后，鼻拭子中仍持续检测到活病毒。这项研究还表明，牛奶中存在的中和抗体可以防止感染，因为另一组喂食来自受感染奶牛的牛奶的小牛也没有被感染，也没有表现出临床症状或血清转化。这些数据表明，从 H5N1 阳性奶牛群或可疑奶牛的人类食品供应中转移的牛奶不应在未经巴氏灭菌的情况下喂养犊牛，因为 H5N1 可能进一步适应牛呼吸道，并且尚未评估犊牛作为农场间传播来源的风险。随着乳制品界 HPAI 特征的不断确定，传播途径的确定是为后续干预和疫苗接种策略研究提供信息的重要步骤。

title: Metabolic licensing of quiescent glioblastoma activation and immune evasion via astrocyte-mitochondria shuttle
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Reactivating quiescent tumor cells at the invasive margin are either eliminated by immune surveillance or expand through immune escape. The mechanisms underpinning phenotypic plasticity driving expansion leading to therapeutic resistance, dissemination, and recurrence remain elusive. Here we establish a metabolic licensing paradigm wherein reactive astrocytes awaken dormant glioblastoma cells and simultaneously confer immune evasion through intercellular mitochondrial transfer. Astrocyte-derived mitochondria, enriched with the one carbon metabolism enzyme SHMT2, deliver functional metabolic units that reprogram recipient glioma cells. This shuttled cargo fuels S adenosylmethionine production, driving m⁶A RNA methylation and release of paused RNA polymerase II over a specific set of genes. Ribosome biogenesis and focal adhesion pathways are selectively upregulated consequently, which enables rapid proliferation and immune resistance of tumour cells. Genetic ablation of astrocytic Shmt2 or pharmacological blockade of mitochondrial transfer suppresses quiescent cell reactivation and delays tumor progression. Our findings thus establish the astrocyte-mitochondria shuttle as a core vulnerability in glioblastomas, linking metabolic crosstalk to epitranscriptomic control of reactivation and immune escape.
title_zh: 通过星形胶质细胞-线粒体穿梭激活静止胶质母细胞瘤和免疫逃避的代谢许可
abstract_zh: 侵袭边缘重新激活的静止肿瘤细胞要么通过免疫监视消除，要么通过免疫逃逸扩大。表型可塑性驱动扩张导致治疗耐药、传播和复发的基础机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们建立了一种代谢许可范例，其中反应性星形胶质细胞唤醒休眠的胶质母细胞瘤细胞，同时通过细胞间线粒体转移赋予免疫逃避。星形胶质细胞衍生的线粒体富含一碳代谢酶 SHMT2，可提供功能性代谢单元，对受体神经胶质瘤细胞进行重新编程。这种穿梭货物促进了 S 腺苷甲硫氨酸的产生，驱动 m⁶A RNA 甲基化和在一组特定基因上暂停的 RNA 聚合酶 II 的释放。核糖体生物发生和粘着斑途径因此选择性上调，从而使肿瘤细胞能够快速增殖和免疫抵抗。星形细胞 Shmt2 的基因消除或线粒体转移的药理阻断可抑制静止细胞的重新激活并延缓肿瘤进展。因此，我们的研究结果将星形胶质细胞-线粒体穿梭确定为胶质母细胞瘤的核心脆弱性，将代谢串扰与再激活和免疫逃逸的表观转录组控制联系起来。

title: CFAP100 forms phase-separated condensates required for ciliary transition zone assembly
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Cilia are microtubule-based cellular protrusions critical for cell signaling and motility. The ciliary transition zone connects axonemal microtubules to the ciliary membrane and functions as a gatekeeper by regulating selective targeting and sorting of proteins. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying its assembly remain incompletely understood. Herein, we identify an important role for cilia and flagella associated protein 100 (CFAP100) in the transition zone assembly. Cfap100 knockout mice exhibit ciliary defects in multiple organs, including the brain, trachea, and kidney. Super-resolution imaging reveals that CFAP100 forms a ring-like structure at the distal end of centrioles. Molecular analyses demonstrate that CFAP100 stimulates the transition zone assembly and interacts with nephrocystin-3 (NPHP3), a component of the inversin compartment that localizes adjacent to the transition zone. Further investigation shows that CFAP100 contains an intrinsically disordered region and forms dynamic biomolecular condensates during ciliogenesis, which are sufficient to promote transition zone assembly. Moreover, the phase separation capacity of CFAP100 correlates with its ability to recruit NPHP3. Together, our findings reveal a mechanism through which CFAP100 phase separation promotes ciliary transition zone assembly, providing insights into the physicochemical principle governing ciliogenesis.
title_zh: CFAP100 形成睫状过渡区组装所需的相分离冷凝物
abstract_zh: 纤毛是基于微管的细胞突起，对细胞信号传导和运动至关重要。纤毛过渡区将轴丝微管与纤毛膜连接起来，并通过调节蛋白质的选择性靶向和分类来充当看门人。然而，其组装背后的分子机制仍不完全清楚。在此，我们确定了纤毛和鞭毛相关蛋白 100 (CFAP100) 在过渡区组装中的重要作用。 Cfap100 基因敲除小鼠在多个器官中表现出纤毛缺陷，包括大脑、气管和肾脏。超分辨率成像显示CFAP100在中心粒远端形成环状结构。分子分析表明，CFAP100 刺激过渡区组装并与肾囊肿素 3 (NPHP3) 相互作用，后者是位于过渡区附近的反转蛋白区室的一个组成部分。进一步的研究表明，CFAP100 含有一个本质上无序的区域，并在纤毛发生过程中形成动态的生物分子凝聚物，这足以促进过渡区的组装。此外，CFAP100 的相分离能力与其招募 NPHP3 的能力相关。总之，我们的研究结果揭示了 CFAP100 相分离促进纤毛过渡区组装的机制，为控制纤毛发生的物理化学原理提供了见解。

title: Fatty acid oxidation fuels mitochondrial respiration to drive epidermal stem cell fate and differentiation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Skin barrier function relies on the epidermis, whose integrity is maintained by basal stem cells that continuously renew and differentiate into a multilayered architecture. Disrupted epidermal differentiation underlies numerous hyperproliferative and inflammatory skin disorders. While transcriptional and epigenetic mechanisms are known to regulate late differentiation, the molecular events driving early commitment remain elusive. Here, we reveal that early mitochondrial reprogramming, characterized by the activation of oxidative phosphorylation, is a determinant of differentiation initiation. We identify fatty acid oxidation as the primary metabolic pathway fueling oxidative phosphorylation during this process. Pharmacological and genetic inhibition of fatty acid oxidation, in vitro and in vivo, disrupts differentiation and compromises stratification, causing defective responses to physical insults. Mechanistically, fatty acid oxidation enables ATP production in committed epidermal cells to support the differentiation process, linking lipid metabolism and epidermal homeostasis. These results uncover an unrecognized role for metabolic reprogramming in epidermal stem cell fate and highlight fatty acid oxidation as a promising therapeutic target for restoring differentiation defects in disease.
title_zh: 脂肪酸氧化促进线粒体呼吸，从而驱动表皮干细胞的命运和分化
abstract_zh: 皮肤屏障功能依赖于表皮，其完整性由基底干细胞维持，基底干细胞不断更新并分化成多层结构。表皮分化破坏是许多过度增殖和炎症性皮肤病的基础。虽然已知转录和表观遗传机制可以调节晚期分化，但驱动早期分化的分子事件仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了以氧化磷酸化激活为特征的早期线粒体重编程是分化起始的决定因素。我们将脂肪酸氧化确定为在此过程中促进氧化磷酸化的主要代谢途径。体外和体内脂肪酸氧化的药理学和遗传抑制会破坏分化并损害分层，导致对物理损伤的反应缺陷。从机制上讲，脂肪酸氧化使定型表皮细胞能够产生 ATP，以支持分化过程，将脂质代谢和表皮稳态联系起来。这些结果揭示了代谢重编程在表皮干细胞命运中未被认识的作用，并强调脂肪酸氧化是恢复疾病分化缺陷的有希望的治疗靶点。

title: YTHDC1 functions as a molecular chaperone to suppress ALS-linked hnRNPA1 mutants from aggregation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Proteostasis failure drives multiple neurodegenerative disorders (NDs), and ATP-independent chaperone pathways that support neuronal proteostasis remain poorly defined. Here, we identify the N6-methyladenosine (m6A)-binding protein YTHDC1 as an ATP-independent molecular chaperone, whose activity is mediated by a highly acidic polyaspartate/glutamate (polyD/E) segment. YTHDC1 prevents protein misfolding and aggregation, unfolds kinetically trapped substrates, and resolubilizes pre-formed aggregates. Deletion of the polyD/E segment abolishes these activities, whereas aromatic-cage mutants retain chaperone activity, demonstrating independence from m6A recognition. We identify the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-associated RNA-binding protein hnRNPA1 as a YTHDC1 client. YTHDC1 maintains liquid-like hnRNPA1 condensates, delays fibrillization of disease-associated mutants, and limits stress-granule sequestration, while mitigating mutant hnRNPA1-induced neurite growth defects in primary neurons. These findings define a proteostatic function of YTHDC1 and highlight its chaperone activity as a potential target for mitigating protein aggregation in ALS-related NDs.
title_zh: YTHDC1 作为分子伴侣抑制 ALS 连接的 hnRNPA1 突变体聚集
abstract_zh: 蛋白质稳态失败会导致多种神经退行性疾病 (ND)，而支持神经元蛋白质稳态的不依赖于 ATP 的伴侣通路仍不清楚。在这里，我们将 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 结合蛋白 YTHDC1 鉴定为不依赖于 ATP 的分子伴侣，其活性由高酸性聚天冬氨酸/谷氨酸 (polyD/E) 片段介导。 YTHDC1 防止蛋白质错误折叠和聚集，展开动力学捕获的底物，并重新溶解预先形成的聚集体。 PolyD/E 片段的删除消除了这些活性，而芳香笼突变体保留了分子伴侣活性，证明了与 m6A 识别的独立性。我们将肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 相关 RNA 结合蛋白 hnRNPA1 确定为 YTHDC1 客户端。 YTHDC1 维持液体状 hnRNPA1 凝聚物，延迟疾病相关突变体的原纤维化，并限制应激颗粒隔离，同时减轻突变体 hnRNPA1 诱导的原代神经元神经突生长缺陷。这些发现定义了 YTHDC1 的蛋白抑制功能，并强调其伴侣活性是减轻 ALS 相关 ND 中蛋白质聚集的潜在靶标。

title: Retroviruses use different IP6 binding mechanisms to alter the properties of their capsids
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: HIV-1 uses the metabolite inositol hexakisphosphate (IP6) as a host factor to assemble its capsid, but whether this strategy is unique to lentiviruses or represents a common feature of retroviral capsids remains unclear. Here we show that IP6 binding is conserved across diverse retroviruses but occurs through distinct capsid sites and mechanisms, and influences viral behaviour. In contrast to HIV-1, the beta-retrovirus Mason-Pfizer Monkey Virus (MPMV) and the gamma-retrovirus Murine Leukaemia Virus (MLV) bind IP6 at the threefold lattice interface between capsomers rather than within capsomer pores. Cryo-EM structures of core-like particles reveal that two lysine residues from each capsomer coordinate IP6 between either two discrete three-lysine rings (MPMV) or a single heterogeneous six-lysine ring (MLV). MPMV and MLV are largely insensitive to IP6 availability in producer cells, but this binding mode renders them highly dependent on IP6 in target cells – the opposite of the dependency pattern of HIV-1. The way in which retroviruses use IP6 to build their capsids alters their dependence on the metabolite at different stages of the replicative cycle and in key capsid behaviours, such as assembly and stability.
title_zh: 逆转录病毒使用不同的 IP6 结合机制来改变其衣壳的特性
abstract_zh: HIV-1使用代谢物肌醇六磷酸（IP6）作为宿主因子来组装其衣壳，但这种策略是慢病毒独有的还是代表逆转录病毒衣壳的共同特征仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明 IP6 结合在不同的逆转录病毒中是保守的，但通过不同的衣壳位点和机制发生，并影响病毒行为。与 HIV-1 不同，β 逆转录病毒梅森-辉瑞猴病毒 (MPMV) 和 γ 逆转录病毒鼠白血病病毒 (MLV) 在壳粒之间的三重晶格界面处而不是在壳粒孔内结合 IP6。核状颗粒的冷冻电镜结构表明，每个壳粒的两个赖氨酸残基在两个离散的三赖氨酸环 (MPMV) 或单个异质六赖氨酸环 (MLV) 之间配位 IP6。 MPMV 和 MLV 对生产细胞中 IP6 的可用性基本上不敏感，但这种结合模式使它们高度依赖于靶细胞中的 IP6——与 HIV-1 的依赖模式相反。逆转录病毒使用 IP6 构建衣壳的方式改变了它们在复制周期的不同阶段以及关键衣壳行为（例如组装和稳定性）对代谢物的依赖。

title: CD11b agonist GB1275 potentiates oncolytic bacterial therapy against pancreatic cancer in mouse tumor models
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Oncolytic bacteria are microorganisms with cytotoxic activity capable of lysing cancer cells while simultaneously activating both innate and adaptive immune responses to exert anti-tumor effects. However, the innate immune activation targeting oncolytic bacteria within the tumor microenvironment (TME) is a limiting factor. Here we find that the CD11b-targeting agonist GB1275 can modulate bacteria-immune interaction and inhibit the infiltration of CD11b⁺ innate immune cells such as neutrophils and macrophages, thereby suppressing the antimicrobial immune defenses in the TME in mice. This then avoids the clearance of oncolytic bacteria and increases the efficacy of bacteria-mediated tumor immunotherapy. Furthermore, the gemcitabine-loaded bacteria combined with GB1275 treatment activate innate immune responses in tumor, as mediated by Toll-like receptors (TLR), NOD-like receptors (NLR) and cGAS-STING pathways, while simultaneously enhancing dendritic cell (DC)-dependent antigen cross-presentation; this then upregulates the adaptive anti-tumor immune response and inhibits the growth of both subcutaneous and in situ pancreatic cancers in mouse tumor models. Our results therefore demonstrate that modulating innate immune responses while subsequently strengthening adaptive immune activation can significantly improve the efficacy of bacteria-mediated tumor immunotherapy.
title_zh: CD11b 激动剂 GB1275 增强小鼠肿瘤模型中针对胰腺癌的溶瘤细菌疗法
abstract_zh: 溶瘤细菌是具有细胞毒活性的微生物，能够溶解癌细胞，同时激活先天性和适应性免疫反应以发挥抗肿瘤作用。然而，针对肿瘤微环境（TME）内溶瘤细菌的先天免疫激活是一个限制因素。在这里，我们发现CD11b靶向激动剂GB1275可以调节细菌-免疫相互作用并抑制CD11b⁺先天免疫细胞（如中性粒细胞和巨噬细胞）的浸润，从而抑制小鼠TME中的抗菌免疫防御。这样就可以避免溶瘤细菌的清除，并提高细菌介导的肿瘤免疫疗法的功效。此外，负载吉西他滨的细菌与 GB1275 治疗相结合，可激活肿瘤中由 Toll 样受体 (TLR)、NOD 样受体 (NLR) 和 cGAS-STING 通路介导的先天免疫反应，同时增强树突状细胞 (DC) 依赖性抗原交叉呈递；然后，这会上调适应性抗肿瘤免疫反应，并抑制小鼠肿瘤模型中皮下和原位胰腺癌的生长。因此，我们的结果表明，调节先天免疫反应，同时加强适应性免疫激活，可以显着提高细菌介导的肿瘤免疫疗法的疗效。

title: Metabolic plasticity supports a flexible nutritional symbiosis in Cardiocondyla ants
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nutritional symbioses have repeatedly evolved in insects, yet how hosts regulate these partnerships to balance benefits across development and environments remains unclear. Ants provide an exceptional system to address this question, as several lineages maintain ancient symbionts that can be naturally lost without harming the host. The invasive tramp ant Cardiocondyla obscurior provides a compelling example of this phenomenon, as the vertically transmitted symbiont Candidatus Westeberhardia cardiocondylae can be lost at the species, colony, and even individual level. By implementing a range of molecular techniques, including dual-RNA sequencing, fluorescent in-situ hybridisations of RNA and qPCR, in conjunction with experimental manipulations of diet, we reveal the regulatory dynamics and function of this labile association. Symbionts provide shikimate-derived nutrients that enhance colony resilience under protein limitation, while hosts appear to regulate symbiont abundance during protein scarcity and cuticle formation to optimise resource allocation. In the symbiont’s absence, ants compensate by upregulating genes enabling tyrosine acquisition from external sources. This metabolic flexibility allows colonies to exploit symbiont-derived and environmental nutrients, sustaining both growth and survival across nutritional contexts. Our findings reveal dynamic host regulation as a mechanism for sustaining the persistence and adaptability of ancient symbioses.
title_zh: 代谢可塑性支持心髁蚂蚁灵活的营养共生
abstract_zh: 营养共生在昆虫中反复进化，但宿主如何调节这些伙伴关系以平衡发展和环境之间的利益仍不清楚。蚂蚁提供了一个特殊的系统来解决这个问题，因为几个谱系维持着古老的共生体，这些共生体可以自然消失而不伤害宿主。入侵的流浪蚂蚁 Cardiocondyla obscurioor 提供了这种现象的一个令人信服的例子，因为垂直传播的共生体 Candidatus Westeberhardia Cardiocondylae 可能会在物种、群体甚至个体层面上消失。通过实施一系列分子技术，包括双 RNA 测序、RNA 荧光原位杂交和 qPCR，结合饮食的实验操作，我们揭示了这种不稳定关联的调控动态和功能。共生体提供源自莽草酸的营养物质，增强蛋白质限制下菌落的恢复力，而宿主似乎在蛋白质稀缺和角质层形成期间调节共生体丰度，以优化资源分配。在共生体缺失的情况下，蚂蚁通过上调基因来补偿，从而能够从外部来源获取酪氨酸。这种代谢灵活性使菌落能够利用共生体衍生的营养物质和环境营养物质，在营养环境中维持生长和生存。我们的研究结果揭示了动态宿主调节是维持古代共生体持久性和适应性的机制。

title: Heatwaves favour acyclic monoterpene emissions in tropical forests
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Heatwaves perturb plant physiology and monoterpene emissions, with important consequences for atmospheric chemistry and climate. Acyclic and cyclic monoterpenes differ markedly in their chemical reactivity, biosynthetic pathways, physiological functions, and atmospheric impacts, yet their heatwave responses remain poorly quantified, and current emission models generally assign them similar temperature sensitivities. Here, we combine leaf warming experiments, heatwave observations, and temperature-response modeling to show that acyclic monoterpenes from tropical trees in South China possess substantially higher temperature sensitivity than cyclic forms. As a result, heatwaves shift ambient mixture toward acyclic compounds, which approach half of measured monoterpenes and dominate calculated ozone and hydroxyl-radical reactivity. Default temperature algorithms in current emission models fail to reproduce this cyclic-to-acyclic shift, whereas the revised temperature functions developed here successfully capture the observed increase in acyclic fraction. Climate extremes may therefore alter atmospheric chemistry not only by changing monoterpene abundance, but also by reshaping monoterpene composition.
title_zh: 热浪有利于热带森林中的无环单萜排放
abstract_zh: 热浪扰乱植物生理和单萜排放，对大气化学和气候产生重要影响。无环和环状单萜在化学反应性、生物合成途径、生理功能和大气影响方面存在显着差异，但它们的热浪响应仍然很难量化，并且当前的排放模型通常赋予它们相似的温度敏感性。在这里，我们结合叶片变暖实验、热浪观测和温度响应模型，表明来自华南热带树木的无环单萜比环状单萜具有更高的温度敏感性。结果，热浪将环境混合物转向无环化合物，这些化合物接近测量的单萜的一半，并主导计算的臭氧和羟基自由基反应性。当前排放模型中的默认温度算法无法重现这种循环到非循环的转变，而此处开发的修订温度函数成功捕获了观察到的非循环分数的增加。因此，极端气候可能不仅通过改变单萜丰度，而且通过重塑单萜成分来改变大气化学。

title: Persistent influence of the North Atlantic Oscillation on Late Holocene hydroclimate in southwestern Greenland
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how global climate forcing shapes regional hydroclimate on decadal to millennial timescales is critical for predicting the response of continental ice sheets to future warming. Because instrumental observations capture only a short interval, longer-term perspectives require proxy records. Here we present a high-resolution sedimentary record covering the entire Holocene from southwestern Greenland. We show that after the demise of local glaciers in the Early Holocene, the record allows evaluation of millennial to decadal variations in local precipitation. Comparison with North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) reconstructions and climate model simulations demonstrates that positive NAO phases correspond to wetter but colder regional conditions. These findings suggest that centennial-scale patterns of ice mass balance during the late Holocene were influenced by precipitation variability, in addition to temperature changes. While the sensitivity to precipitation variability may change under a warmer climate, our results underscore the importance of integrating shifts in NAO-driven moisture delivery to accurately assess the future stability of the Greenland Ice Sheet.
title_zh: 北大西洋涛动对格陵兰岛西南部全新世晚期水文气候的持续影响
abstract_zh: 了解全球气候强迫如何在十年到千年的时间尺度上塑造区域水文气候对于预测大陆冰盖对未来变暖的反应至关重要。由于仪器观测只能捕获较短的时间间隔，因此需要更长期的视角来替代记录。在这里，我们展示了覆盖格陵兰岛西南部整个全新世的高分辨率沉积记录。我们表明，在全新世早期当地冰川消亡后，记录可以评估当地降水的千年到十年的变化。与北大西洋涛动 (NAO) 重建和气候模型模拟的比较表明，正 NAO 阶段对应于更潮湿但更寒冷的区域条件。这些发现表明，除了温度变化之外，全新世晚期冰质量平衡的百年尺度模式还受到降水变化的影响。虽然在气候变暖的情况下对降水变化的敏感性可能会发生变化，但我们的结果强调了整合 NAO 驱动的水分输送变化以准确评估格陵兰冰盖未来稳定性的重要性。

title: Self-reconstruction of single copper atoms drives precise hydroxyl radicals generation for efficient water disinfection
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria (ARB) and their genes (ARGs) pose a significant risk to public health and the ecosystem. Conventional water disinfection efficiently eliminates pathogens, however, it requires intensive chemical consumption but inefficiently removes ARGs. Herein, we propose an on-demand electrochemical platform that simultaneously eliminate both ARB and ARGs with in-situ generated hydroxyl radicals (·OH) without additional chemical inputs. Single-atom copper catalysts with CuN4 coordination structure (SA-CuN4/NC) are precisely tuned to directly convert oxygen into controllable ·OH via three-electron oxygen reduction reaction (3e⁻ ORR). Operando X-ray adsorption near-edge spectroscopy reveals a potential-driven self-reconstruction of single-atom Cu sites to optimize ·OH concentration. Specially, the preferentially adsorbed H+ onto the adjacent N atoms promotes the breaking of Cu-N bonds to form stable Cu2-CuN2 cluster as a genuine active site. As expected, the SA-CuN4/NC with moderate ·OH (~11.5 μM) exhibits ultra-fast degradation of E. coli HT115, accomplishing an ~ 8 log removal within 1 min and a complete elimination of ARGs in 30 min. Excess ·OH (~47.9 μM) triggers bacterial aggregation which compromises bacterial inactivation. These findings demonstrate that 3e⁻ ORR is a sustainable and effective strategy to obtain fast and complete water disinfection, preventing environmental spread of ARGs.
title_zh: 单铜原子的自重构驱动精确的羟基自由基生成，实现高效水消毒
abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药细菌（ARB）及其基因（ARG）对公众健康和生态系统构成重大风险。传统的水消毒可以有效消除病原体，但需要大量的化学物质消耗，但去除 ARG 的效率较低。在此，我们提出了一种按需电化学平台，可以通过原位生成的羟基自由基（·OH）同时消除ARB和ARG，而无需额外的化学输入。具有CuN4配位结构的单原子铜催化剂（SA-CuN4/NC）经过精确调节，可通过三电子氧还原反应（3e⁻ ORR）直接将氧转化为可控·OH。 Operando X 射线吸附近边光谱揭示了单原子 Cu 位点的电势驱动自重构，以优化·OH 浓度。特别是，优先吸附到相邻 N 原子上的 H+ 促进 Cu-N 键的断裂，形成稳定的 Cu2-CuN2 簇作为真正的活性位点。正如预期的那样，具有中等·OH (~11.5 μM) 的 SA-CuN4/NC 表现出对大肠杆菌 HT115 的超快速降解，在 1 分钟内实现约 8 log 的去除，并在 30 分钟内完全消除 ARG。过量的·OH (~47.9 μM) 会引发细菌聚集，从而损害细菌失活。这些发现表明，3e⁻ ORR 是一种可持续且有效的策略，可实现快速、彻底的水消毒，防止 ARG 的环境传播。

title: Native and introduced megafauna have convergent effects on animals and ecosystems: a meta-analysis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Introduced large herbivores (henceforth megafauna) are thought to have ‘harmful’ effects on ecosystems by disrupting coevolutionary dynamics. If this is the case, their effects should be distinct from those of native megafauna. We use a systematic meta-analytic dataset of 3,532 observations from 235 articles to test whether there is any difference between the effects of native, introduced, and invasive megafauna on animals, soil, and a variety of ecosystem processes. Among 32 ecological responses, we only find moderate evidence that invasive megafauna have more neutral effects on soil compaction than native megafauna. We then compare the effects of introduced megafauna to intact African megafauna assemblages, the closest proxies for the communities that dominated Earth’s continents for millions of years. We find moderate evidence that introduced megafauna reduces soil magnesium more than African megafauna, but no differences among the other responses. Our results suggest that nativeness is unlikely to be a biological attribute of megafauna. While the effects of introduced megafauna may seem unusual in reference to modern defaunated baselines, we suggest that broader lenses—and objective research across the cascading indirect effects of megafauna—will help us better understand the role of introduced megafauna in a time of rising global novelty.
title_zh: 本地和引进的巨型动物对动物和生态系统具有趋同影响：一项荟萃分析
abstract_zh: 人们认为引入的大型食草动物（以下称为巨型动物群）会破坏共同进化动态，从而对生态系统产生“有害”影响。如果是这样的话，它们的影响应该与本地巨型动物的影响不同。我们使用包含 235 篇文章的 3,532 个观察结果的系统荟萃分析数据集来测试本地、引进和入侵巨型动物对动物、土壤和各种生态系统过程的影响是否存在差异。在 32 种生态反应中，我们只发现了适度的证据，表明入侵巨型动物对土壤压实的影响比本地巨型动物更中性。然后，我们将引入的巨型动物群与完整的非洲巨型动物群落的影响进行比较，这是统治地球大陆数百万年的群落的最接近代表。我们发现了适度的证据表明，引入的巨型动物比非洲巨型动物对土壤镁的减少更多，但其他反应之间没有差异。我们的结果表明，本土性不太可能是巨型动物的生物学属性。虽然相对于现代动物区系丧失的基线而言，引入的巨型动物的影响可能看起来不寻常，但我们建议更广泛的视角以及对巨型动物的级联间接影响的客观研究将帮助我们更好地了解引入的巨型动物在全球新颖性不断上升的时代所发挥的作用。

title: Directed evolution of an enantiocomplementary SNArase reveals divergent catalytic features
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Enzymes that catalyze non-natural C–C bond-forming reactions are powerful tools in asymmetric synthesis, yet reprogramming their active sites to invert stereochemical outcome remains challenging. Building on our recently engineered SNArase, SNAr1.3, which performs enantioselective nucleophilic aromatic substitutions with carbon nucleophiles, we now report the evolution of an enantiocomplementary biocatalyst (eSNAr1.3) that displays enhanced activity and expanded substrate scope. Structural and computational analyses uncover both conserved and divergent features between SNAr1.3 and eSNAr1.3. Despite retaining similar electrophile binding poses and a conserved catalytic arginine, the halide-binding pocket of SNAr1.3 has been abandoned in eSNAr1.3. Instead, His23 has emerged as a key motif that works with Arg124 to accurately position the nucleophilic substrate. Calculations reveal that Arg124 also plays a crucial role in facilitating halide release during catalysis. Our study demonstrates how evolution can reshape enzyme mechanisms in unforeseen ways, highlighting the importance of exploring diverse trajectories to access new functions.
title_zh: 对映互补 SNArase 的定向进化揭示了不同的催化特征
abstract_zh: 催化非天然 C-C 键形成反应的酶是不对称合成的强大工具，但重新编程其活性位点以反转立体化学结果仍然具有挑战性。基于我们最近设计的 SNArase SNAr1.3，它可以用碳亲核试剂进行对映选择性亲核芳香族取代，我们现在报告了对映互补生物催化剂 (eSNAr1.3) 的进化，该催化剂显示出增强的活性和扩大的底物范围。结构和计算分析揭示了 SNAr1.3 和 eSNAr1.3 之间的保守特征和差异特征。尽管保留了类似的亲电子结合姿势和保守的催化精氨酸，但 SNAr1.3 的卤化物结合口袋在 eSNAr1.3 中已被放弃。相反，His23 已成为与 Arg124 一起精确定位亲核底物的关键基序。计算表明，Arg124 在催化过程中促进卤化物释放方面也发挥着至关重要的作用。我们的研究展示了进化如何以不可预见的方式重塑酶机制，强调了探索不同轨迹以获得新功能的重要性。

title: 18 Month patency of acellular bioengineered regenerative conduit as coronary artery bypass
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Coronary artery bypass grafting remains the standard of care for complex coronary artery disease; however, outcomes are limited by failure or lack of suitable native vessels. Tissue-engineered vascular grafts have shown promise in peripheral applications, yet durable performance in coronary circulation remains unmet. In this study, tissue-engineered vessels are implanted with and without external support as coronary artery bypass grafts in an ovine model and anticoagulants are administered for 180 days. Unsupported vessels fail early due to kink-related thrombus, whereas external supported vessels achieve 100% patency at 180 days. Further, two animals are followed through 550 days without anticoagulant to maintain patency. The tissue engineered vessel explants demonstrate host-mediated remodeling including endothelium, no thrombus, minimal inflammatory response, and burst pressures exceeding native coronary bypass grafts. This study demonstrates preliminary, long-term patency after withdrawal of anticoagulation, with evidence of regenerative transformation into a living, functional vessel.
title_zh: 非细胞生物工程再生导管作为冠状动脉搭桥术的通畅期为 18 个月
abstract_zh: 冠状动脉旁路移植术仍然是复杂冠状动脉疾病的标准治疗方法；然而，由于失败或缺乏合适的本地船只，结果受到限制。组织工程血管移植物在外周应用中显示出前景，但在冠状循环中的持久性能仍未得到满足。在这项研究中，在有或没有外部支撑的情况下，在绵羊模型中植入组织工程血管作为冠状动脉旁路移植术，并施用抗凝剂 180 天。无支撑的血管由于扭结相关的血栓而早期失效，而外部支撑的血管在 180 天时实现 100% 通畅。此外，两只动物在不使用抗凝剂的情况下进行了 550 天的随访，以保持通畅。组织工程血管外植体表现出宿主介导的重塑，包括内皮、无血栓、最小的炎症反应以及超过天然冠状动脉旁路移植物的爆破压力。这项研究证明了撤消抗凝治疗后的初步长期通畅，并有证据表明其可以再生转化为活的、有功能的血管。

title: Electron-Rich Azo Sites on Ordered Mesoporous Covalent Organic Frameworks Boosting Redox Kinetics in Aqueous Zn-I2 Batteries
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The practical application of aqueous zinc–iodine (Zn-I2) batteries is frequently hindered by the notorious shuttle effect of polyiodides and sluggish redox kinetics. To overcome these challenges, two isostructural mesoporous covalent organic frameworks (COFs) were synthesized via the condensation of 1,3,5-triformylphloroglucinol (TP) with either 4,4′-azodianiline (AZO) or benzidine (BD), yielding AZO-TP-COF and BD-TP-COF, respectively. When employed as cathode hosts in Zn-I2 batteries, the AZO-TP-COF@I2 composite delivered a specific capacity of about 228 mAh g–1 at 0.2 A g–1, along with remarkable rate capability and long-term cycling stability (95% capacity retention after 3000 cycles at 3 A g–1), better than those of BD-TP-COF@I2. This enhanced performance of the AZO-TP-COF@I2 cathode is attributed to the electron-rich azo moieties in AZO-TP-COF, which effectively suppress the polyiodide shuttle effect and facilitate the adsorption and conversion of I–/I2/I3– species. These findings highlight the pivotal role of azo-based engineering in COFs for regulating redox mediators in metal-halogen batteries.
title_zh: 有序介孔共价有机框架上的富电子偶氮位点促进水性 Zn-I2 电池中的氧化还原动力学

title: Flexible Non-Enzymatic Glucose Sensors via Electrospray Reduction of Copper Nanoparticles on Laser-Induced Graphene
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Non-enzymatic glucose sensors have the advantages of low cost, high sensitivity, stability, and good shelf life. The porous laser-induced graphene (LIG) on flexible substrates obtained by a simple fabrication process shows good conductivity and porous morphology advantageous for sensing. Herein, flexible and non-enzymatic glucose biosensors are fabricated based on a composite of copper nanoparticles (CuNPs) anchored on LIG. The fabrication process involved a non-contact, simple, and cost-effective electrospray reduction (ESR) deposition technology, where an aqueous copper ion solution serves as the ESR precursor. The positively charged micro-scaled droplets generated by electrospray act as micro-reactors, in which the potential difference between the charged droplets and the negatively biased substrate drives the in situ reduction of Cu2+ to CuNPs. This non-contact ESR process enables the conformal deposition of CuNP catalysts on LIG, utilized here for glucose sensing. The size and distributions of the CuNPs can be tuned by the ESR parameters. The optimized sensors demonstrate excellent performance for glucose detection in KOH alkaline electrolyte, exhibiting a sensitivity of 622.9 μA·mM−1·cm−2, a limit of detection of 29.73 μM, and a wide linear range from 0.05 to 10 mM, as well as remarkable repeatability and selectivity for glucose. The ability for detection of glucose in neutral PBS buffer (pH 7.4) was also demonstrated. The ESR process provides a rapid and green fabrication of reliable non-enzymatic glucose sensors and presents a promising processing strategy for wearable and flexible health monitoring devices.

title: Identification of a spatially organized TREM2-associated permissive macrophage niche in human pulmonary tuberculosis alveolar pneumonia
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB), caused by lung infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), often manifests both alveolar pneumonia and aggregation of immune cells containing Mtb, termed granulomas, within the same lung. Here, we integrate spatial transcriptomics, single-cell RNA sequencing, high-resolution imaging, and functional assays of lung biopsies from four men with pulmonary TB to compare alveolar pneumonia with adjacent granulomas. We find that alveolar TB pneumonia is enriched for TREM2⁺ lipid-laden macrophages characterized by increased lipid metabolism gene expression, reduced T cell infiltration, attenuated antimicrobial gene expression, and abundant Mtb transcripts and antigens. By contrast, neighboring granulomas exhibit organized lymphoid architecture and robust antimicrobial programs. In vitro, Mtb lipids induce TREM2 expression, activate TREM2–DAP12 signaling, and promote lipid droplet accumulation in primary human monocyte-derived macrophages (MDM). Furthermore, TREM2+ MDMs are more susceptible to in vitro Mtb infection. When treating MDMs with 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D₃, which induces antimicrobial macrophage programs, TREM2+ MDM numbers, lipid droplet abundance and Mtb viability are decreased. Thus, we propose a spatially localized, alveolar pneumonia-intrinsic TREM2⁺ macrophage program that potentially contributes to Mtb persistence in pulmonary TB infection in humans.

title: Health and nutrition returns to clean cooking fuel access across the rural-urban divide
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Energy Policy
abstract: Access to clean cooking fuels is central to advancing health, equity, and environmental sustainability worldwide. However, despite sustained policy efforts, a substantial share of households, especially in developing countries, still rely on polluting fuels, with adverse effects on health, environmental quality, and economic well-being. This paper draws on a panel dataset of 102 developing countries spanning 2000–2022 to assess the relationship between access to clean cooking fuels and human well-being. Using fixed-effects and instrumental-variable estimators, we address potential endogeneity concerns. We further explore heterogeneity across rural and urban settings and show that improvements in access are associated with larger gains in health and nutrition outcomes in urban areas. Focusing on sub-Saharan Africa, we conduct scenario-based simulations to quantify the potential benefits of expanding access to clean cooking fuels. Increasing rural access from 10% to 25% is estimated to prevent around 84,000 infant deaths and reduce child stunting by approximately 1.68 million cases. In urban areas, achieving universal access from a baseline of 35% coverage could avert up to 377,000 infant deaths and generate more than 11 million disability-adjusted life years saved, reflecting a substantial reduction in disease burden linked to household air pollution. These results point to the need to accelerate progress toward universal access to clean cooking fuels through targeted, context-specific policies. While rural populations remain underserved and require continued attention, the magnitude of potential gains in urban areas underscores the case for a balanced strategy in clean energy policy design.

title: Warming-driven rise in soil moisture entropy signals growing instability risk in the Asian Water Tower
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Tibetan Plateau (TP), known as the Asian Water Tower, supplies water to billions of people but is undergoing rapid warming and wetting. Whether this increased moisture stabilizes the regional hydrological system or merely provides a transient buffer remains unclear. Here we apply an entropy-based framework to quantify the structural organization of the TP’s soil moisture system. During 2000–2024, regional wetting has driven a long-term decline in entropy, reflecting an increase in system order and enhanced hydrological buffering capacity. This ordering is modulated by ENSO, which regulates regional heterogeneity via a spatial dipole. However, CMIP6 projections reveal a reversal: entropy increases under continued warming and regional contrasts intensify, with some models exhibiting transition-like behavior. Our findings suggest that while current wetting provides a stabilizing buffer, continued warming is projected to amplify spatial heterogeneity, thereby elevating instability risk in the Asian Water Tower and threatening downstream water security.

title: Photon-Transport Interface Optimization of GAGG:Ce Scintillating Waveguides for Radio-Photovoltaic Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Radio-photovoltaic (RPV) cells can provide self-powered and long-lifetime electricity for complex and harsh environments, but their energy conversion efficiency is limited by interfacial losses during radiation-to-light and light-to-electricity conversion. Here, we propose a photon-transport interface engineering strategy for RPV cells driven by radioisotope radiation sources, using a GAGG:Ce scintillating waveguide as the radiation-to-light conversion layer. The original scintillator layer suffers from radioluminescence (RL) absorption at the radiation-source loading surface and low edge light extraction efficiency (27.6%). Because the refractive index of GAGG:Ce is high, only a limited fraction of isotropically generated RL photons can directly escape from a smooth GAGG:Ce/air interface within one pass. An annealed 100 nm Ag reflective film reduces photon leakage from the main surface, improves RL photon transport, and maintains low particle-energy absorption at sufficiently high incident energies, producing a 20.8% enhancement in emission intensity. In parallel, a disordered rough edge surface improves photon extraction by changing local emission angles; Under the present open-edge configuration, the edge with an Sa value of 434.2 nm produces the highest measured output, corresponding to an edge-emission enhancement of at least 77% relative to the smooth edge. Together, these interfacial modifications improve edge emission and electrical output, yielding a maximum electrical power of 0.648 μW at an X-ray tube voltage of 30 kV and current of 1.0 mA. An absolute ECE is not reported because the X-ray power incident on and absorbed by the scintillator was not independently calibrated.

title: Asymmetric Dual-Responsive Switch-Based Janus Photothermal Mask for Dynamic Humidity–Thermal Regulation
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Maintaining a dynamic humidity–thermal balance within the skin–device microclimate is critical for enhancing wearability and minimizing physiological and psychological discomfort. Herein, we present an asymmetric dual-responsive MXene/Viscose-PP (MVP) actuator integrated into a Janus photothermal mask for skin–mask microclimate dynamic humidity–thermal regulation. The MVP actuator switch with asymmetric bending deformation can achieve autonomous on–off switching under temperature and humidity stimulation. The Janus photothermal mask enables unidirectional transport of exhaled breath condensate to the outer hydrophilic layer and enhances evaporation efficiency by 22.5 times. The synergistic integration of the Janus photothermal interface and the MVP actuator switch establishes a closed-loop dynamic humidity–thermal regulation system. The smart switch-based Janus photothermal mask achieves a state of humidity–thermal comfort during prolonged wearing. Such a closed-loop strategy offers a transformative route toward next-generation adaptive personal protective equipment and smart textiles, enabling autonomous human–machine humidity–thermal interaction without external energy consumption.

title: Metasurface-Based Multifunctional Optically Transparent Electromagnetic Window: Switchable Transmission, Broadband Scattering Suppression, and Infrared Control
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Reconfigurable optically transparent metasurfaces provide a promising platform for integrating dynamic electromagnetic (EM) regulation and optical observation. However, achieving simultaneous microwave regulation, scattering control, and infrared regulation within a single transparent architecture remains challenging. Here, we propose an optically transparent multispectral reconfigurable EM window featuring switchable dual-band microwave transmission, broadband scattering suppression, and dynamic infrared radiation regulation. By integrating tunable-resistance PIN diodes, the proposed metasurface overcomes the fixed-frequency limitation of conventional transparent EM windows, enabling switchable dual-band transmission at 4/9 GHz with continuous amplitude modulation. Furthermore, a planar bridging-inductor feeding scheme is developed to integrate the bias network with transparent meta-atoms without additional feeding lines or metallized vias. Through frequency-tailored co-design of the active transmission layer and passive scattering layer, broadband scattering suppression from 3.7 to 12.8 GHz is achieved while preserving the transmission windows. In addition, electrically controlled heating of the transparent metallic mesh enables dynamic regulation of infrared radiation characteristics. This work provides a versatile strategy for actively controlled multispectral transparent metasurfaces, offering promising applications in intelligent EM windows, adaptive communication and sensing platforms, and multispectral regulation systems.
title_zh: 基于超表面的多功能光学透明电磁窗：可切换传输、宽带散射抑制和红外控制
abstract_zh: 摘要 可重构的光学透明超表面为集成动态电磁（EM）调节和光学观测提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，在单一透明架构中同时实现微波调节、散射控制和红外调节仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了一种光学透明的多光谱可重构电磁窗口，具有可切换的双频带微波传输、宽带散射抑制和动态红外辐射调节。通过集成可调电阻 PIN 二极管，所提出的超表面克服了传统透明电磁窗口的固定频率限制，实现了 4/9 GHz 的可切换双频传输和连续幅度调制。此外，还开发了平面桥接电感器馈电方案，将偏置网络与透明元原子集成，无需额外的馈线或金属化通孔。通过有源传输层和无源散射层的频率定制协同设计，在保留传输窗口的同时实现了 3.7 至 12.8 GHz 的宽带散射抑制。此外，透明金属网的电控加热能够动态调节红外辐射特性。这项工作为主动控制的多光谱透明超表面提供了一种通用策略，在智能电磁窗口、自适应通信和传感平台以及多光谱调节系统中提供了有前景的应用。

title: Enhancement in Charge-Trapping Efficiency for InGaZnO Vertical-Channel Memory Transistors via Gate-Stack Engineering: Validation in the 40 nm Scaling Regime
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The continuous demand for higher bit density in 3D NAND flash memory has accelerated the pursuit of Z-scaling as a means of managing total chip profiles. Amorphous In-Ga-Zn-O (a-IGZO) with a 0.49:1:1.73 atomic ratio, deposited at 200 °C, has been identified as a promising channel material for scaled devices; however, the efficient electrical erase operation remains a significant bottleneck. In this work, we demonstrate an ultra-scaled vertical charge-trap memory thin-film transistor (V-CTM TFT) integrating this a-IGZO channel and a nanocrystalline ZnO charge-trap layer. The introduction of an H2O-based Al2O3 tunneling layer (TL) resulted in the activation of interfacial trap-assisted tunneling, while simultaneously tailoring the bulk properties of the ZnO layer. This oxidant-driven TL engineering has been demonstrated to enhance charge injection via interfacial oxygen vacancies, as well as to tailor the trap states within the ZnO layer, facilitating an expanded memory window without complex hole injection. Optimized for devices with a channel length of 60 nm and validated in an ultra-scaled 40 nm regime, the V-CTM TFT achieved a substantial memory window (∼10 V) and stable triple-level cell operation despite aggressive scaling. Furthermore, excellent high-temperature operational reliability at 80 °C and high cell-to-cell reproducibility (both within-wafer and run-to-run) were confirmed, providing a highly reliable and reproducible design strategy for future high-density 3D memory architectures.
title_zh: 通过栅极堆栈工程提高 InGaZnO 垂直沟道存储晶体管的电荷捕获效率：40 nm 缩放机制中的验证
abstract_zh: 摘要 3D NAND 闪存对更高位密度的持续需求加速了对 Z 缩放作为管理总体芯片配置的手段的追求。原子比为 0.49:1:1.73 的非晶 In-Ga-Zn-O (a-IGZO) 在 200 °C 下沉积，已被认为是用于缩放器件的有前途的通道材料；然而，高效的电擦除操作仍然是一个重大瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们展示了一种集成了 a-IGZO 沟道和纳米晶 ZnO 电荷捕获层的超大规模垂直电荷捕获存储薄膜晶体管 (V-CTM TFT)。基于 H2O 的 Al2O3 隧道层 (TL) 的引入导致了界面陷阱辅助隧道的激活，同时调整了 ZnO 层的体特性。这种氧化剂驱动的 TL 工程已被证明可以通过界面氧空位增强电荷注入，并调整 ZnO 层内的陷阱状态，从而无需复杂的空穴注入即可扩大存储窗口。 V-CTM TFT 针对沟道长度为 60 nm 的器件进行了优化，并在超大规模 40 nm 范围内进行了验证，尽管尺寸大幅缩小，但仍实现了较大的存储窗口 (∼10 V) 和稳定的三级单元操作。此外，还证实了 80°C 下出色的高温运行可靠性和高单元间再现性（晶圆内和运行间），为未来高密度 3D 存储架构提供了高度可靠和可再现的设计策略。
