title: Bioinspired Hemostatic Dressings for Rapid and Safe Bleeding Control Via Nanofiber Bridging of Kaolin and Cotton
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Emergency hemostasis during prehospital care significantly reduces trauma‐related mortality. Nanoclay exhibits potent procoagulant properties, but its detachment from the substrate leads to non‐negligible adverse reactions and diminished hemostatic efficiency, hindering its clinical application. Despite improved immobilization via polymer incorporation, irreversible surface encapsulation undermines the procoagulant efficacy of nanoclays. Here, inspired by the anchoring mechanism of fish scales to skin via collagen fibers, we introduce a nanofiber‐bridged design that enables robust immobilization of nanoclay and maximized loading density, while also achieving its full exposure for optimal hemostatic performance. The microfiber‐derived nanofiber network expands the interfacial contact area and anchors nanosheet inner surfaces via synergistic covalent and non‐covalent interactions, effectively redistributing stress to resist dynamic shear forces. The resulting kaolin‐cotton hemostatic dressing demonstrates superior physical stability (no detectable kaolin leakage) and enhanced hemostatic efficacy in rat (62%), rabbit (58%), and pig (35%–43%) hemorrhage models compared with conventional hemostatic agents. Importantly, no leakage‐induced chronic inflammation was observed. Moreover, laboratory‐scale preparation and processing of 5 kg products demonstrate the feasibility of industrial‐scale production, making them further processable into various cotton‐based materials. This bioinspired dressing offers improved efficacy and safety, along with affordability, underscoring its potential for clinical translation.
title_zh: 通过高岭土和棉花的纳米纤维桥接实现快速、安全控制出血的仿生止血敷料
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  院前护理期间的紧急止血可显着降低创伤相关死亡率。纳米粘土具有有效的促凝血特性，但其与基材的分离会导致不可忽视的不良反应并降低止血效率，阻碍了其临床应用。尽管通过聚合物掺入改善了固定性，但不可逆的表面封装破坏了纳米粘土的促凝血功效。在这里，受到鱼鳞通过胶原纤维锚定到皮肤的机制的启发，我们引入了一种纳米纤维桥接设计，可以实现纳米粘土的牢固固定和最大化的负载密度，同时还可以实现其完全暴露以获得最佳止血性能。微纤维衍生的纳米纤维网络扩大了界面接触面积，并通过协同共价和非共价相互作用锚定纳米片内表面，有效地重新分布应力以抵抗动态剪切力。与传统止血剂相比，所得的高岭土棉止血敷料在大鼠（62%）、兔（58%）和猪（35%–43%）出血模型中表现出优异的物理稳定性（未检测到高岭土渗漏）和增强的止血效果。重要的是，没有观察到渗漏引起的慢性炎症。此外，5公斤产品的实验室规模制备和加工证明了工业规模生产的可行性，使其可进一步加工成各种棉基材料。这种仿生敷料可提高功效和安全性，并且价格实惠

title: Unconventional Dendrite‐Free Deposition of Mg Metal Anodes at Low Temperatures
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Temperature plays a critical role in governing the plating behavior of metallic anodes by regulating ionic conductivity of the electrolyte, desolvation energy, and charge transfer processes in the solid‐electrolyte interphase (SEI). While low temperature commonly triggers dendritic growth on metallic anodes (e.g., Li, Na, and Zn), the temperature effect on Mg plating/stripping behaviors remains unknown thus far. Herein, we report an unconventional temperature‐dependent deposition behavior of Mg anodes that tends to form dendrite‐free deposits at low temperatures. Integration of cryo‐transmission electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy, and x‐ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals that the SEI layer formed at low temperatures has an ultrathin thickness (∼2‐3 nm) and is enriched in high‐modulus inorganic compounds, which facilitates the uniform deposition of Mg anodes. As a result, the Mg metal anode realizes an exceptional average Coulombic efficiency up to 99.92% over 2000 cycles at −20°C. This study demonstrates the unconventional deposition behavior of Mg metal anodes at low temperatures, underpinning their potential for low‐temperature applications and advancing the fundamental understanding of metal deposition.
title_zh: 低温下镁金属阳极的非常规无枝晶沉积
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  温度通过调节电解质的离子电导率、去溶剂化能和固体电解质界面（SEI）中的电荷转移过程，在控制金属阳极的电镀行为中发挥着关键作用。虽然低温通常会引发金属阳极（例如锂、钠和锌）上的枝晶生长，但迄今为止温度对镁电镀/剥离行为的影响仍然未知。在此，我们报告了镁阳极的非常规温度依赖性沉积行为，该行为往往在低温下形成无枝晶沉积物。低温透射电子显微镜、原子力显微镜和X射线光电子能谱的结合表明，在低温下形成的SEI层具有超薄的厚度（~2-3 nm），并且富含高模量无机化合物，有利于镁阳极的均匀沉积。因此，镁金属阳极在 -20°C 下经过 2000 次循环后，平均库仑效率高达 99.92%。这项研究证明了镁金属阳极在低温下的非常规沉积行为，支撑了其低温应用的潜力，并增进了对金属沉积的基本理解。

title: Halogen‐Free Solvent and Additive‐Processed Organic Solar Cells Achieving 20.50% Binary Efficiency
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Transitioning to halogen‐free solvent processing is essential for the scalable manufacturing of organic solar cells (OSCs), yet it remains challenging due to severe molecular aggregation and unfavorable phase separation. Additive engineering can effectively modulate film morphology, but it always relies on halogen‐based interactions with photoactive materials, compromising environmental sustainability. Herein, we developed three novel halogen‐free additives, namely cyclohexylbenzene (ChB), 1,4‐dicyclohexylbenzene (DChB), and 1,3,5‐tricyclohexylbenzene (TChB), which are benzene derivatives substituted with different numbers of cyclohexyl groups. These additives enable precise regulation of molecular packing and crystallization through distinct steric hindrance effects and additive–acceptor interactions. Both theoretical and experimental investigations reveal that the bulky cyclohexyl groups preferentially adsorb onto the terminal units of L8‐BO, creating steric spacers that effectively suppress excessive aggregation during the halogen‐free solvent processing. Moreover, the additives serve as kinetic mediators during spin‐coating to promote compact terminal packing of L8‐BO, while their subsequent thermal volatilization further promotes well‐ordered long‐range crystallinity. The resulting microstructure significantly enhances charge utilization, enabling D18:L8‐BO OSCs to achieve a record‐breaking efficiency of 20.50% with improved operational stability. This work underscores the unique advantage of halogen‐free additives in selectively modulating molecular aggregation, enabling dual eco‐friendly fabrication and paving the way for commercialization of high‐performance organic photovoltaics.
title_zh: 无卤溶剂和添加剂加工有机太阳能电池实现 20.50% 二元效率
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  过渡到无卤溶剂加工对于有机太阳能电池（OSC）的可扩展制造至关重要，但由于严重的分子聚集和不利的相分离，它仍然具有挑战性。增材工程可以有效地调节薄膜形态，但它始终依赖于卤素与光敏材料的相互作用，从而损害了环境的可持续性。在此，我们开发了三种新型无卤添加剂，即环己基苯（ChB）、1,4-二环己基苯（DChB）和1,3,5-三环己基苯（TChB），它们是被不同数量的环己基取代的苯衍生物。这些添加剂能够通过独特的空间位阻效应和添加剂-受体相互作用来精确调节分子堆积和结晶。理论和实验研究表明，大的环己基优先吸附到 L8-BO 的末端单元上，形成空间间隔基，有效抑制无卤溶剂加工过程中的过度聚集。此外，添加剂在旋涂过程中充当动力学介体，促进L8-BO的紧密末端堆积，而它们随后的热挥发进一步促进有序的长程结晶度。由此产生的微观结构显着提高了电荷利用率，使 D18:L8-BO OSC 能够实现 20.50% 的破纪录效率，同时提高了运行稳定性。这项工作强调了无卤添加剂在选择性调节 m 方面的独特优势。

title: Quantum nonlinearity for optical neural computing
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The rapid scaling of deep neural networks comes at the cost of unsustainable power consumption. While optical neural networks offer an alternative, their capabilities remain constrained by the lack of efficient optical nonlinearities. To address this, we propose an optical neural computing architecture by embedding quantum emitters in inverse-designed nanophotonic structures. Due to their saturability, quantum emitters exhibit exceptionally strong nonlinearity compared with conventional materials. Using physics-aware training, we numerically demonstrate that the proposed architecture can solve complex tasks, including nonlinear classification and reinforcement learning, within all-optical neural networks. To enable fair comparison across different platforms, we introduce a framework that quantitatively links nonlinearity to a network’s expressive power. Analysis shows that our quantum activation operates at nW/μm2 intensity, which is seven orders of magnitude below the nonlinearity threshold of conventional optical materials. Looking ahead to large language models, we estimate the nonlinearity-limited optical power, which scales sublinearly with model size. Our results indicate that quantum nanophotonics may provide a route toward sustainable AI inference.
title_zh: 光学神经计算的量子非线性
abstract_zh: 深度神经网络的快速扩展是以不可持续的功耗为代价的。虽然光学神经网络提供了一种替代方案，但它们的能力仍然受到缺乏有效光学非线性的限制。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种光学神经计算架构，将量子发射器嵌入逆向设计的纳米光子结构中。由于其饱和性，与传统材料相比，量子发射器表现出异常强的非线性。使用物理感知训练，我们以数字方式证明所提出的架构可以解决全光神经网络中的复杂任务，包括非线性分类和强化学习。为了实现不同平台之间的公平比较，我们引入了一个框架，该框架将非线性与网络的表达能力定量联系起来。分析表明，我们的量子激活在 nW/μm2 强度下运行，比传统光学材料的非线性阈值低七个数量级。展望大型语言模型，我们估计了非线性限制的光功率，它随模型大小呈次线性缩放。我们的结果表明，量子纳米光子学可能为可持续人工智能推理提供一条途径。

title: Self-locking non-volatile coding metasurfaces via origami-based mechanical bits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Digital coding metasurfaces have revolutionized electromagnetic (EM) manipulation, yet typical tunable approaches based on active components suffer from “volatility”. While mechanical modulation provides a potential solution, current implementations generally lack inherent state-locking capabilities, rendering them vulnerable to environmental disturbances and actuation errors. Inspired by the concept of mechanical bits (MBs), this paper presents a self-locking non-volatile coding metasurface platform enabled by Kresling origami-based MBs. Here, the mechanical bi-stability of individual meta-atoms enables robust binary geometric reconfiguration, with distinct states protected by intrinsic energy barriers. Building upon this concept, equivalent current models accounting for the compression-torsion coupling motion are established and analyzed to design efficient and broadband 1-bit EM units. By integrating tailored metallic patterns onto a multi-material 3D-printed truss-variant array, both transmission- and reflection-type prototypes are proposed and experimentally demonstrated, exhibiting reliable wavefront manipulation capabilities through near-field holographic imaging and far-field beam steering. These results bridge mechanical logic and EM information processing, establishing a universal physical paradigm for constructing low-power, highly robust coding metasurfaces resilient to complex environments.
title_zh: 通过基于折纸的机械钻头自锁非易失性编码超表面
abstract_zh: 数字编码超表面彻底改变了电磁 (EM) 操纵，但基于有源组件的典型可调谐方法却存在“波动性”。虽然机械调制提供了一种潜在的解决方案，但当前的实现通常缺乏固有的状态锁定功能，使得它们容易受到环境干扰和驱动错误的影响。受机械位（MB）概念的启发，本文提出了一种由基于 Kresling 折纸的 MB 实现的自锁非易失性编码超表面平台。在这里，单个元原子的机械双稳定性能够实现稳健的二元几何重构，并具有受内在能量势垒保护的不同状态。基于这一概念，建立并分析了考虑压缩扭转耦合运动的等效电流模型，以设计高效且宽带的 1 位 EM 单元。通过将定制的金属图案集成到多材料 3D 打印桁架变体阵列上，提出并实验演示了透射型和反射型原型，通过近场全息成像和远场光束控制展现了可靠的波前操纵能力。这些结果将机械逻辑和电磁信息处理联系起来，建立了一个通用的物理范例，用于构建能够适应复杂环境的低功耗、高度鲁棒的编码超表面。

title: Revealing 3D strain and carbide architectures in additively manufactured Ni superalloys
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Laser Additive Manufacturing (LAM)-induced directional solidification creates complex microstructures in nickel-based superalloys, featuring columnar grains with cellular sub-grains and carbides. Using Scanning 3D X-ray Diffraction (S3DXRD), we reveal orientation and intergranular strain relationships coupled to cellular sub-grain networks and primary cubic MC carbides. We analyzed 3D orientation and elastic strain fields across 82 γ grains and 37,000+ carbides in an ABD-900AM alloy produced via Directed Energy Deposition (DED). Cooling-induced solute segregation creates volumetric lattice parameter patterning in the γ phase, altering residual stress fields. Ti-, Ta-, and Nb-rich carbides form preferentially in these high-solute regions, exhibiting weak orientation relationships with parent γ grains. These results provide the first non-destructive 3D study linking rapid solidification segregation, deformation heterogeneity, and carbide architectures in additively manufactured Ni-superalloys. These insights provide crucial detail to rationalise LAM process parameter optimisation and the coupled spatially governed structural performance.
title_zh: 揭示增材制造镍高温合金的 3D 应变和碳化物结构
abstract_zh: 激光增材制造 (LAM) 诱导的定向凝固在镍基高温合金中形成复杂的微观结构，具有柱状晶、蜂窝状亚晶和碳化物。使用扫描 3D X 射线衍射 (S3DXRD)，我们揭示了与细胞亚晶网络和初生立方 MC 碳化物耦合的取向和晶间应变关系。我们分析了通过定向能量沉积 (DED) 生产的 ABD-900AM 合金中 82 个 γ 晶粒和 37,000 多个碳化物的 3D 取向和弹性应变场。冷却引起的溶质偏析在 γ 相中产生体积晶格参数图案，从而改变残余应力场。富含 Ti、Ta 和 Nb 的碳化物优先在这些高溶质区域中形成，与母体 γ 晶粒表现出弱的取向关系。这些结果提供了第一个将增材制造的镍高温合金中的快速凝固偏析、变形不均匀性和碳化物结构联系起来的无损 3D 研究。这些见解为 LAM 工艺参数优化和耦合空间控制结构性能的合理化提供了重要的细节。

title: Non-Hermitian topology from edge transport in Hermitian quantum anomalous Hall systems
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Non-Hermitian physics, known for phenomena like exceptional points and the skin effect, has been most prominently realized in engineered systems relying on controlled gain and loss. Here we show that it can also arise naturally as an intrinsic transport response of a globally Hermitian quantum anomalous Hall system, without the need for external non-Hermitian engineering. We show that the interplay between unidirectional chiral edge modes and diffusive normal edge modes induces intrinsic non-reciprocal transport described by a continuum Hatano-Nelson model. Consequently, the non-Hermitian skin effect is encoded directly in experimentally accessible Hall-bar observables: the electrochemical potential and local heat dissipation acquire chirality-dependent exponential spatial profiles, while the longitudinal conductance decays exponentially with system size and the Hall conductance remains quantized. Using Landauer–Büttiker simulations, we confirm these transport signatures and identify magnetic topological insulators as a realistic platform for an intrinsic non-Hermitian transport response. Our results bridge non-Hermitian topology with mesoscopic transport, opening a pathway toward non-Hermitian topological devices in solid-state systems.
title_zh: 厄米量子反常霍尔系统中边缘传输的非厄米拓扑
abstract_zh: 非厄米物理学以异常点和集肤效应等现象而闻名，在依赖控制增益和损耗的工程系统中得到了最显着的实现。在这里，我们证明它也可以作为全局厄米量子反常霍尔系统的固有输运响应自然出现，而不需要外部非厄米工程。我们证明，单向手征边缘模式和扩散法向边缘模式之间的相互作用会引起连续介质 Hatano-Nelson 模型描述的内在非互易输运。因此，非厄米集肤效应直接编码在实验上可访问的霍尔棒可观测值中：电化学势和局部散热获得手性相关的指数空间分布，而纵向电导随系统尺寸呈指数衰减，并且霍尔电导保持量子化。使用 Landauer-Büttiker 模拟，我们确认了这些传输特征，并将磁性拓扑绝缘体确定为固有非厄米传输响应的现实平台。我们的结果将非厄米拓扑与介观输运联系起来，为固态系统中的非厄米拓扑器件开辟了一条途径。

title: Yolk-shell zeolite nanoreactors enable multi-poison resistance for NOx reduction
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The practical application of selective catalytic reduction with ammonia (NH3-SCR) for NOx abatement from stationary sources is severely restricted by catalyst deactivation induced by SO2 and alkali metal poisons in flue gas. Although integrating transition metal oxides with zeolites is widely pursued to enhance catalyst poisoning tolerance, most reported strategies have inherent limitations. Conventional loading approaches deliver high active phase loading but leave active sites directly exposed to poisons, whereas confinement strategies offer shielding protection but typically suffer from limited active phase content. Herein, we demonstrate the concept of a zeolite-confined nanoreactor by constructing a yolk-shell structured catalyst, in which high-content (> 10 wt.%) MnFeOx nanoparticles are encapsulated within a hollow ZSM-5 zeolite shell. In situ extended X-ray absorption fine structure spectroscopy (EXAFS) and diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier-transform spectroscopy (DRIFTS), combined with density functional theory (DFT) calculations, reveal a synergistic dual-shielding mechanism: the ZSM-5 zeolite shell physically hinders SO2 from accessing and poisoning the inner active oxides core, while its intrinsic framework Brønsted acid sites chemically suppress SO2 adsorption and trap alkali metal species. Consequently, the catalyst maintains over 95% NOx conversion at 250 °C under co-poisoning by SO2 and potassium. This work establishes hollow zeolite-confined nanoreactors as an effective and versatile platform for developing durable NOx emission control catalysts applicable to industrially relevant multi-poisoning conditions.
title_zh: 蛋黄壳沸石纳米反应器具有多重抗毒作用，可减少氮氧化物
abstract_zh: 氨选择性催化还原（NH3-SCR）用于固定源NOx减排的实际应用受到烟气中SO2和碱金属毒物引起的催化剂失活的严重限制。尽管人们广泛寻求将过渡金属氧化物与沸石结合以增强催化剂中毒耐受性，但大多数报道的策略都具有固有的局限性。传统的负载方法提供高活性相负载，但使活性位点直接暴露于毒物，而限制策略提供屏蔽保护，但通常受到活性相含量有限的影响。在此，我们通过构建蛋黄壳结构催化剂展示了沸石限制纳米反应器的概念，其中高含量（> 10 wt.%）MnFeOx纳米颗粒被封装在中空的ZSM-5沸石壳内。原位扩展X射线吸收精细结构光谱（EXAFS）和漫反射红外傅里叶变换光谱（DRIFTS），结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，揭示了一种协同的双重屏蔽机制：ZSM-5沸石壳在物理上阻碍SO2进入并毒害内部活性氧化物核，而其内在框架布朗斯台德酸位点在化学上抑制SO2吸附并捕获碱金属物种。因此，在 SO2 和钾共中毒的情况下，该催化剂在 250 °C 下仍能保持 95% 以上的 NOx 转化率。这项工作将空心沸石限制纳米反应器建立为开发耐用的氮氧化物排放控制催化剂的有效且多功能的平台

title: Gradual Destruction of Refractory Stardust in Alkali Brines on Asteroid Bennu
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Carbonaceous asteroids preserve presolar grains—refractory stardust that predates the Solar System—recording both their stellar origins and subsequent alteration on their parent asteroids. Here we examine the distribution of presolar grains and isotopically anomalous organic matter in mottled particles from samples returned by the OSIRIS-REx mission from asteroid Bennu. Although the mottled samples contain organic matter with carbon and nitrogen isotopic compositions similar to those of other Bennu samples, they lack presolar silicate or oxide grains and show a markedly reduced abundance of presolar silicon carbide. In this work, we show that these findings are consistent with the slow destruction of silicon carbide grains during late-stage alteration by a low-temperature, oxidizing, alkaline brine. These brines, coinciding with evaporite salt formation, selectively erased chemically robust presolar phases while preserving isotopically anomalous organic matter. This shows that evolved aqueous fluids can fundamentally alter the presolar record of primitive asteroids.
title_zh: 小行星贝努碱盐水中难熔星尘的逐渐破坏
abstract_zh: 碳质小行星保存着太阳前颗粒——早于太阳系的难熔星尘——记录了它们的恒星起源以及随后在其母体小行星上的变化。在这里，我们研究了奥西里斯-雷克斯任务从小行星本努返回的样本中斑驳颗粒中太阳前颗粒和同位素异常有机物的分布。尽管斑驳的样本含有与其他贝努样本相似的碳和氮同位素组成的有机物，但它们缺乏前太阳系硅酸盐或氧化物颗粒，并且显示出前太阳系碳化硅丰度显着降低。在这项工作中，我们表明这些发现与低温、氧化性碱性盐水在后期蚀变过程中碳化硅颗粒的缓慢破坏是一致的。这些盐水与蒸发盐的形成同时发生，选择性地消除了化学上稳定的前太阳相，同时保留了同位素异常的有机物。这表明演化出的水性液体可以从根本上改变原始小行星的太阳前记录。

title: Composites of covalently linked lignin and cellulose from one feedstock
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Future biorefineries must upgrade all constituents of lignocellulosic feedstocks to high-value products. To curb land-use pressure, technologies that upgrade existing side-streams from forestry and agriculture into substitutes for high-impact, fossil-derived materials are urgently needed. Prevailing biomass valorization typically prioritizes either cellulose pulp or lignin; true co-valorization remains uncommon. Here we report a metal-free, ambient-pressure reactive fractionation that concurrently yields high-quality cellulose and a functionalized lignin. The isolated lignin is etherified and subsequently covalently coupled to cellulose via epoxide ring-opening, producing a composite. The materials display mechanical performance equivalent to common packaging materials, with retention under wet conditions, overcoming the intrinsic limitations of hydrogen-bonded cellulose networks. By integrating mild fractionation with chemical upgrading, this strategy simplifies processing, broadens the product slate accessible from residual biomass side streams and advances the substitution of problematic packaging materials. These findings establish a scalable route to whole-biomass co-valorization and wet-tolerant bio-based packaging from residual streams.
title_zh: 来自一种原料的共价连接的木质素和纤维素的复合材料
abstract_zh: 未来的生物精炼厂必须将木质纤维素原料的所有成分升级为高价值产品。为了遏制土地使用压力，迫切需要将现有林业和农业副产品升级为高影响力化石衍生材料的替代品的技术。普遍的生物质增值通常优先考虑纤维素纸浆或木质素；真正的共同增值仍然不常见。在此，我们报告了一种无金属、常压反应分馏，可同时产生高质量的纤维素和功能化木质素。分离出的木质素被醚化，随后通过环氧化物开环与纤维素共价偶联，产生复合材料。该材料表现出与普通包装材料相当的机械性能，在潮湿条件下具有保留性，克服了氢键纤维素网络的固有局限性。通过将温和分馏与化学升级相结合，该策略简化了加工，扩大了可从残余生物质侧流中获得的产品种类，并促进了有问题的包装材料的替代。这些发现建立了一条可扩展的路线，用于从残余流中进行全生物质共价和耐湿生物基包装。

title: In-silico solute transport via perivascular networks in the human intracranial space
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The mechanisms of intracranial solute transport are fundamental to human brain health. However, our understanding of their interplay remains incomplete, in part due to the complexity of integrating insights across scales, between species, and from different modalities. In this work, we combine mixed-dimensional mathematical modeling, multi-modal magnetic resonance images, and high performance computing to present a computational framework for calculating the spatiotemporal spreading of a solute across the subarachnoid space, ventricular system, and brain parenchyma, including surface perivascular spaces. To illustrate applicability, we simulate a series of scenarios relating to intrathecal tracer injections, including variations in cerebrospinal fluid production, intracranial pulsatility, perivascular fluid flow and -structure. This openly available framework allows for evaluating the integrated effect of different transport mechanisms, bridging from the vascular mesoscale to the organ-level macroscale and across time scales of seconds to hours, in subject-specific geometries.
title_zh: 通过人体颅内血管周围网络进行模拟溶质运输
abstract_zh: 颅内溶质转运机制对于人类大脑健康至关重要。然而，我们对它们相互作用的理解仍然不完整，部分原因是整合跨尺度、物种之间和不同模式的见解的复杂性。在这项工作中，我们结合了混合维数学模型、多模态磁共振图像和高性能计算，提出了一个计算框架，用于计算溶质在蛛网膜下腔、脑室系统和脑实质（包括表面血管周围空间）中的时空扩散。为了说明适用性，我们模拟了一系列与鞘内示踪剂注射相关的场景，包括脑脊液产生、颅内搏动、血管周围液体流动和结构的变化。这个公开可用的框架允许评估不同运输机制的综合效应，从血管介观尺度到器官级宏观尺度，跨秒到小时的时间尺度，在特定主题的几何形状中。

title: Catalyst-controlled regiodivergence in enantioselective synthesis of spirocyclic γ- versus δ-lactams
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: We report a regiodivergent strategy for the catalytic asymmetric synthesis of enantioenriched spirocyclic γ- and δ-lactams from a single cyclic alkyne-tethered β-ketoamide precursor. Critically, simply switching the catalyst system between Cu(I)/Pyrabox and Ni(II)/Box enables precise toggling of the cyclization between 5-exo-dig and 6-endo-dig modes, allowing direct and highly stereoselective access to either γ-lactam or δ-lactam spirocycles, each bearing a challenging quaternary spiro-stereocenter. The method exhibits broad functional group compatibility and allows for gram-scale synthesis. Mechanistic experiments and DFT calculations reveal that regioselectivity arises from the mode of metal coordination or the joint regulation by metal and ligand, whereas stereocontrol is governed by steric hindrance between the ligand and the substrate. This practical and atom-economical approach provides a powerful platform for the divergent synthesis of privileged spirocyclic pharmacophores.
title_zh: 螺环 γ- 与 δ-内酰胺对映选择性合成中催化剂控制的区域发散
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一种区域发散策略，用于从单个环炔束缚的β-酮酰胺前体催化不对称合成对映体富集的螺环γ-和δ-内酰胺。重要的是，只需在 Cu(I)/Pyrabox 和 Ni(II)/Box 之间切换催化剂系统，就可以在 5-exo-dig 和 6-endo-dig 模式之间精确切换环化，从而允许直接和高度立体选择性地获得 γ-内酰胺或 δ-内酰胺螺环，每个螺环都具有具有挑战性的四元螺立体中心。该方法表现出广泛的官能团兼容性，并允许克级合成。机理实验和DFT计算表明，区域选择性源于金属配位模式或金属与配体的联合调控，而立体控制则由配体与底物之间的空间位阻控制。这种实用且原子经济的方法为特殊螺环药效团的发散合成提供了强大的平台。

title: Programmable regiodivergent light-driven cyclization of acyclic 1,5-dienes unlocks rigid bicyclic architectures
source: Nature Chemistry
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Controlling regioselectivity in radical cyclizations remains a major challenge in synthetic chemistry, hindering the efficient assembly of strained, rigid bicyclic architectures from simple acyclic precursors. Here we show that a visible-light-mediated intramolecular [2 + 2] photocycloaddition of aza-1,5-dienes can successfully overcome the classical ‘rule-of-five’ selectivity governing radical cyclizations. By tuning the electronic properties of an easily removable amide N-substituent, we reprogram the initial energy-transfer-driven cyclization event, diverging from the usually kinetically favoured 5-
                    exo
                    -trig to the 6-
                    endo
                    -trig pathway. As a result, closely related substrates can be selectively directed to generate either bridged bicyclo[2.1.1] or vastly underexplored fused bicyclo[2.2.0] architectures, both of which offer rich downstream derivatization potential. Furthermore, an extensive computational study of this transformation revealed how the intricate interplay of electronic effects controls reaction regioselectivity. Overall, this work establishes a programmable, light-driven cyclization strategy that enables precise and selective construction of distinct bicyclic frameworks within a unified reaction manifold.
title_zh: 无环 1,5-二烯的可编程区域发散光驱动环化解锁刚性双环结构
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    控制自由基环化中的区域选择性仍然是合成化学中的一个主要挑战，阻碍了从简单的无环前体有效组装出紧张的刚性双环结构。在这里，我们表明，可见光介导的氮杂-1,5-二烯分子内[2 + 2]光环加成可以成功克服控制自由基环化的经典“五法则”选择性。通过调整易于去除的酰胺 N-取代基的电子特性，我们重新编程了初始能量转移驱动的环化事件，与通常动力学上有利的 5-
                    exo
                    -触发到6-
                    内切
                    -trig途径。因此，可以选择性地引导密切相关的底物生成桥联双环[2.1.1]或尚未充分开发的稠合双环[2.2.0]结构，这两种结构都提供丰富的下游衍生化潜力。此外，对这种转变的广泛计算研究揭示了电子效应的复杂相互作用如何控制反应区域选择性。总的来说，这项工作建立了一种可编程的、光驱动的环化策略，能够在统一的反应流形内精确、选择性地构建不同的双环框架。

title: Brittle materials-based fully stretchable organic light-emitting diodes
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Stretchable small-molecule organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) are hampered by random cracking and efficiency degradation of inherently brittle small-molecule organic semiconductors (SMOS) under mechanical deformation, severely limiting their practical application. Herein, we propose an interfacial stress regulation strategy based on a hierarchical architecture. Departing from the conventional crack-suppression paradigm in stretchable optoelectronics, our strategy employs active crack engineering to guide controlled nanocrack formation, enabling the fabrication of nanocracked, fully stretchable OLEDs compatible with inherently brittle SMOS while achieving both high efficiency and excellent stretchability. The devices achieve a maximum brightness of 16,050 cd/m2, current efficiency of 85.7 cd/A, external quantum efficiency of 24.7%, and 250% tensile strain. Stable operation is maintained under complex deformations, while the strategy demonstrates broad universality for multicolor emission. This work offers a general strategy for integrating brittle high-performance SMOS into stretchable displays, advancing the development of wearable and conformal electronics.
title_zh: 基于脆性材料的全可拉伸有机发光二极管
abstract_zh: 可拉伸小分子有机发光二极管（OLED）因固有脆性小分子有机半导体（SMOS）在机械变形下的随机裂纹和效率下降而受到阻碍，严重限制了其实际应用。在这里，我们提出了一种基于分层架构的界面应力调节策略。与可拉伸光电子学中传统的裂纹抑制范例不同，我们的策略采用主动裂纹工程来引导受控纳米裂纹的形成，从而能够制造与本质上脆性的SMOS兼容的纳米裂纹、完全可拉伸的OLED，同时实现高效率和优异的拉伸性。该器件的最大亮度为16,050 cd/m2，电流效率为85.7 cd/A，外量子效率为24.7%，拉伸应变为250%。在复杂变形下保持稳定运行，同时该策略展示了多色发射的广泛普适性。这项工作提供了将脆性高性能 SMOS 集成到可拉伸显示器中的总体策略，推动了可穿戴和共形电子产品的发展。

title: A hardware-implemented adaptive pruning neural network
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: With the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) applications, there is an urgent demand for edge computing hardware with low latency and high energy efficiency. The human brain, a highly parallel and sparsely connected architecture, can efficiently process complex tasks at exceptionally low power consumption, a capability that critically relies on synaptic pruning during neural development. However, current neuromorphic hardware, despite its capability to emulate the human brain for AI tasks, lacks an inherent mechanism to assess the importance of synaptic connections and thus cannot achieve brain-like adaptive synaptic pruning. Here, we demonstrate an adaptive pruning convolutional neural network (APCNN) based on Si-based ferroelectric ambipolar field-effect transistor (Fe-AmFET) crossbar arrays. The reconfigurable ambipolar transport in the Si Fe-AmFET memories enables a single device to implement both positive and negative synaptic weights while intrinsically evaluating connection importance, thereby enabling the crossbar arrays to perform multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, nonvolatile weight storage, and in situ kernel pruning within the network. Our studies indicate that the network achieves an ultrahigh kernel pruning ratio of 89.58% with negligible accuracy degradation on the Fashion-MNIST dataset, while reducing inference parameters, MAC operations, and core power consumption (including the array and readout circuits) by 92.2%, 97.5%, and 92.4%, respectively.
title_zh: 硬件实现的自适应剪枝神经网络
abstract_zh: 随着人工智能（AI）应用的快速增长，对低延迟、高能效的边缘计算硬件有着迫切的需求。人脑是一种高度并行且稀疏连接的架构，能够以极低的功耗高效处理复杂的任务，这种能力严重依赖于神经发育过程中的突触修剪。然而，当前的神经形态硬件尽管能够模拟人脑执行人工智能任务，但缺乏评估突触连接重要性的内在机制，因此无法实现类脑自适应突触修剪。在这里，我们演示了一种基于硅基铁电双极场效应晶体管（Fe-AmFET）交叉阵列的自适应修剪卷积神经网络（APCNN）。 Si Fe-AmFET 存储器中的可重构双极传输使单个器件能够实现正和负突触权重，同时本质上评估连接重要性，从而使交叉开关阵列能够执行乘法累加 (MAC) 操作、非易失性权重存储和网络内的原位内核修剪。我们的研究表明，该网络在 Fashion-MNIST 数据集上实现了 89.58% 的超高内核剪枝率，精度下降可以忽略不计，同时推理参数、MAC 操作和核心功耗（包括阵列和读出电路）分别减少了 92.2%、97.5% 和 92.4%。

title: Fiber Electronics: Integrating Logic, Photodetection, and Wireless Communication on a Single Optical Fiber
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Optical fibers underpin the global information infrastructure, yet their role has remained largely passive—restricted to guiding light rather than processing it. Signal modulation, detection, and logic operations are still performed by external chips, imposing fundamental limits due to optical-electrical conversion losses, coupling complexity, and interconnection power overheads. Here, we propose an integrated fiber-electronics architecture that directly integrates active optoelectronic functionalities onto optical fibers. We demonstrate a multifunctional electronic-photonic system realized on the side-polished surface of a D-shaped optical fiber, incorporating carbon-based logic circuits, photodetectors, optically controlled inverters, and wireless-interface modules. This monolithic platform enables on-fiber logic operation, sensing, and interaction with the surrounding environment. The integrated devices exhibit outstanding performance: a digital inverter with a gain of 32, a five-stage ring oscillator operating at kilohertz frequencies, and a photodetector with a detectivity of 3.82 × 1016 Jones. Furthermore, optically controlled logic responses, temperature sensing, and sub-meter-scale wireless power and radio-frequency signal transmission are achieved. These results establish a proof-of-concept for active electronic and optoelectronic integration within optical fibers, representing a significant step beyond passive transmission media toward intelligent, distributed fiber networks capable of transmission, sensing, computation, and autonomous energy operation.
title_zh: 光纤电子学：在单根光纤上集成逻辑、光电检测和无线通信
abstract_zh: 光纤支撑着全球信息基础设施，但它们的作用在很大程度上仍然是被动的——仅限于引导光而不是处理光。信号调制、检测和逻辑操作仍然由外部芯片执行，由于光电转换损耗、耦合复杂性和互连功率开销而施加了基本限制。在这里，我们提出了一种集成光纤电子架构，将有源光电功能直接集成到光纤上。我们展示了在 D 形光纤的侧面抛光表面上实现的多功能电子光子系统，该系统结合了碳基逻辑电路、光电探测器、光控逆变器和无线接口模块。该单片平台可实现光纤逻辑操作、传感以及与周围环境的交互。集成器件表现出出色的性能：增益为 32 的数字逆变器、工作频率为千赫兹的五级环形振荡器以及探测灵敏度为 3.82 × 1016 琼斯的光电探测器。此外，还实现了光控逻辑响应、温度传感、亚米级无线电力和射频信号传输。这些结果为光纤内的有源电子和光电集成建立了概念验证，代表着超越无源传输介质向能够传输、传感、计算和自主能源操作的智能分布式光纤网络迈出的重要一步。

title: Thiocarbonyl fluoride ligation for bioconjugation
source: National Science Review Advance Access
abstract: Click chemistry has emerged as a transformative technology for molecular linkage, enabling the streamlined construction of functional chemical architectures essential for life science and drug discovery. Groundbreaking achievement has been established through two generations of click chemistry, copper(I)-catalyzed azide–alkyne cycloaddition (CuAAC) triazole annulation and sulfur(VI) fluoride exchange (SuFEx). Near-perfect reactions are always with great demand for ‘reactivity-availability-functionality’ trilogy. Herein, we developed a thiocarbonyl fluoride exchange protocol for thiocarbonyl-functionalized bioconjugations. title_zh: 用于生物共轭的硫代碳酰氟连接

title: Lipid network crosslinked hydrogels control material dynamics across multiple length scales through lipid movement
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Control over network dynamics across length scales is a feature of natural materials challenging to replicate in synthetic hydrogels. Taking inspiration from biological materials that feature lipids as structural elements, we introduce Lipid Network Crosslinked (LINC) hydrogels that exploit the mobility of individual lipids within self-assembled liposomes as covalent, network-crosslinking points. These mobile, covalent crosslinks increase hydrogel stress relaxation rates over 20-fold compared to polymer-only hydrogels with equivalent stiffness. Liposome design parameters, including degree of surface functionalization and tail saturation, provide a means to independently control the macroscale storage moduli and stress relaxation behavior. Finally, we place cell-adhesive ligands onto more mobile or less mobile network elements. Human neural progenitor cells within LINC hydrogels significantly alter their phenotype in response to nanoscale ligand dynamics. These results establish LINC hydrogels as biomimetic materials that leverage nanoscale lipid mobility within a macroscale polymeric network to control dynamics at multiple length scales.
title_zh: 脂质网络交联水凝胶通过脂质运动控制多个长度尺度的材料动力学
abstract_zh: 跨长度尺度的网络动态控制是天然材料的一个特征，难以在合成水凝胶中复制。受到以脂质为结构元素的生物材料的启发，我们推出了脂质网络交联（LINC）水凝胶，它利用自组装脂质体中单个脂质的流动性作为共价网络交联点。与具有同等刚度的纯聚合物水凝胶相比，这些移动的共价交联将水凝胶应力松弛率提高了 20 倍以上。脂质体设计参数，包括表面功能化程度和尾部饱和度，提供了一种独立控制宏观储能模量和应力松弛行为的方法。最后，我们将细胞粘附配体放置到移动性较高或移动性较低的网络元件上。 LINC 水凝胶中的人类神经祖细胞响应纳米级配体动力学而显着改变其表型。这些结果将 LINC 水凝胶确立为仿生材料，利用宏观聚合物网络内的纳米级脂质流动性来控制多个长度尺度的动力学。

title: Anisotropic shape-shifting robotic matter enabling versatile collective behaviors
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Collective robotic systems can exhibit emergent behaviors through local interactions among individual robots, yet most existing platforms rely on sophisticated individuals or complex control strategies to achieve diverse functionalities. Here, we present TriHex, a minimalist robotic unit capable of shape-shifting between triangular and hexagonal shapes using single-motor actuation. Despite its simplicity, collectives of TriHex units display remarkable behavioral diversity through two control dimensions: system configuration and individual unit’s shape-shifting phase. By adjusting these parameters, a static tessellated assembly’s stiffness can be programmed. In discrete assemblies, the system transitions between solid-like and liquid-like states and achieves programmable viscosity. When arranged in cellular configurations with a pre-designed phase difference, the system realizes controllable porosity. Additionally, shape changes enable coordinated collective locomotion, reconfiguration and integrating capabilities of object gripping and transportation. Analytical models and numerical simulations are developed that successfully capture and predict the TriHex collective’s behavior. This work demonstrates that complex collective behaviors can emerge from relatively simple individual units, offering insights for designing scalable and adaptive robotic matter.
title_zh: 各向异性变形机器人物质可实现多种集体行为
abstract_zh: 集体机器人系统可以通过个体机器人之间的本地交互表现出紧急行为，但大多数现有平台依赖于复杂的个体或复杂的控制策略来实现不同的功能。在这里，我们展示了 TriHex，这是一种极简机器人单元，能够使用单电机驱动在三角形和六边形之间进行形状转换。尽管很简单，但 TriHex 单元的集合通过两个控制维度表现出显着的行为多样性：系统配置和单个单元的变形阶段。通过调整这些参数，可以对静态镶嵌装配体的刚度进行编程。在离散组件中，系统在类固体和类液体状态之间转换，并实现可编程粘度。当以预先设计的相位差排列成蜂窝结构时，该系统实现了可控的孔隙率。此外，形状的变化可以实现协调的集体运动、重新配置以及物体抓取和运输的集成能力。开发的分析模型和数值模拟可以成功捕获和预测 TriHex 集体的行为。这项工作表明，复杂的集体行为可以从相对简单的单个单元中产生，为设计可扩展和自适应的机器人物质提供了见解。

title: A 3D conductive amorphous unsaturated-ligand MIL-68(Fe) MOF as room-temperature H2S chemiresistive sensor
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Simultaneously achieving chemiresistive gas sensors with high selectivity, sensitivity, and stability remains a significant challenge. In this study, inspired by the H2S-specific catalytic enzymes in biological systems, we construct an amorphous unsaturated-ligand MIL-68(Fe) 3D MOF via in situ thermal induction. Without the introduction of extrinsic catalytic or conductive components, this MOF modification strategy creates unsaturated Fe atoms within the framework itself. These atoms function dually as catalytic and conductive sites, thereby overcoming the inherent low conductivity of conventional 3D MOFs and enabling the direct construction of chemiresistive sensor for room-temperature molecular olfactory sensing. The targeted water-adsorption-coordinated catalytic mechanism bypasses the limitations of traditional oxygen adsorption processes to achieve unprecedented comprehensive performance, including fingerprint-level selectivity (against 29 interfering gases), superior sensitivity coefficient (~83/ppm), ultra-low measured lower limit (1 ppb), rapid gas sensing response/recovery characteristics (~30 s/73 s), and excellent long-term stability at room temperature.
title_zh: 3D 导电非晶不饱和配体 MIL-68(Fe) MOF 作为室温 H2S 化学电阻传感器
abstract_zh: 同时实现具有高选择性、灵敏度和稳定性的化学电阻气体传感器仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项研究中，受生物系统中H2S特异性催化酶的启发，我们通过原位热感应构建了一种非晶态不饱和配体MIL-68(Fe) 3D MOF。在不引入外在催化或导电成分的情况下，这种 MOF 改性策略在框架本身内产生不饱和 Fe 原子。这些原子具有催化和导电位点的双重功能，从而克服了传统3D MOF固有的低电导率，并能够直接构建用于室温分子嗅觉传感的化学电阻传感器。靶向水吸附协同催化机制绕过了传统氧吸附工艺的局限性，实现了前所未有的综合性能，包括指纹级选择性（针对29种干扰气体）、卓越的灵敏度系数（~83/ppm）、超低的测量下限（1 ppb）、快速气敏响应/恢复特性（~30 s/73 s）以及优异的室温长期稳定性。

title: Confined shear-induced structure discretization enables re-entrant super-repellent metals
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Re-entrant structures are fundamental to achieving robust liquid repellency, especially for low-surface-tension liquids. However, existing fabrication techniques often face a trade-off among mechanical durability, substrate geometry compatibility, large-area processing, and rapid production. Metals, with their inherent robustness, offer a promising substrate, but direct and efficient machining of metallic re-entrant structures remains a significant challenge. Here, we present a one-step mechanical cutting strategy, termed confined shear-induced structure discretization (CSSD), to directly fabricate high-density re-entrant architectures on planar and curved metallic surfaces. By designing a cave-trapezoid composite tool, we achieve a controlled transition from continuous ridges to discrete re-entrant units during ultra-precision diamond turning. The resulting metallic surfaces sustain a super-repellent Cassie–Baxter state for a broad range of liquids, exhibiting a water contact angle of 161.7 ± 2.2°, indicating non-wetting behavior. Notably, this approach enables rapid, large-area manufacturing, with a material removal rate of 1.068 mm3 s−1 over areas up to 1.5 × 104 mm2. The re-entrant textures retain sufficient structural features after 1000 abrasion cycles to recover superhydrophobicity. This geometry-guided strategy reveals a mechanism for the scalable fabrication of discrete microstructures and offers useful guidance for extending the approach to other machining modalities.
title_zh: 受限剪切诱导结构离散化使重入超排斥金属成为可能
abstract_zh: 凹入结构是实现强大的拒液性的基础，特别是对于低表面张力的液体。然而，现有的制造技术常常面临机械耐久性、基板几何兼容性、大面积加工和快速生产之间的权衡。金属以其固有的坚固性提供了一种有前途的基材，但金属凹角结构的直接高效加工仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种一步式机械切割策略，称为受限剪切诱导结构离散化（CSSD），可直接在平面和弯曲金属表面上制造高密度凹入结构。通过设计洞穴梯形复合刀具，我们在超精密金刚石车削过程中实现了从连续脊到离散凹角单元的受控过渡。由此产生的金属表面对多种液体保持超排斥性的 Cassie-Baxter 状态，表现出 161.7 ± 2.2° 的水接触角，表明不润湿行为。值得注意的是，这种方法可以实现快速、大面积制造，在高达 1.5 × 104 mm2 的区域内材料去除率为 1.068 mm3 s−1。经过 1000 次磨损循环后，凹入纹理仍保留足够的结构特征，以恢复超疏水性。这种几何引导策略揭示了离散微结构可扩展制造的机制，并为将该方法扩展到其他加工模式提供了有用的指导。

title: Direct observation of shock-induced formation of davemaoite, Ca-perovskite
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Perovskite-structured silicates are key minerals of Earth’s lower mantle and have also been identified in shocked meteorites as the (Mg,Fe)SiO3-perovskite phase, bridgmanite. In contrast, CaSiO3-perovskite (davemaoite) has never been found in meteorites and is known only from rare inclusions in deep-mantle diamonds. This contrast highlights a fundamental gap: while natural samples provide indirect evidence for silicate perovskites under shock conditions, laboratory dynamic compression experiments have yet to directly capture perovskite transitions in either MgSiO3 or CaSiO3, likely due to kinetic limitations imposed by nanosecond timescales. Here we present the in situ, atomic-scale observations of CaSiO3-perovskite formation under dynamic compression. Using nanosecond laser-driven shocks and ultrafast X-ray diffraction (XRD) at SACLA, we tracked the transformation of CaSiO3 from low-pressure phases to an amorphous state, and ultimately to davemaoite above ~91(10) GPa, suggesting a disorder–order transformation pathway toward reconstructive crystallization on nanosecond timescales. Upon release, davemaoite undergoes amorphization via a transient low-symmetry phase. These observations provide direct structural evidence for silicate perovskite formation under dynamic loading, resolving a long-standing experimental problem and establishing dynamic compression as an effective route to probe deep-mantle minerals relevant to Earth and Ca-rich exoplanet interiors.
title_zh: 直接观察冲击诱导的钙钛矿、钙钛矿的形成
abstract_zh: 钙钛矿结构硅酸盐是地球下地幔的关键矿物，在冲击陨石中也被鉴定为 (Mg,Fe)SiO3-钙钛矿相，即桥石。相比之下，CaSiO3-钙钛矿（davemaoite）从未在陨石中被发现，只能从深地幔钻石中的稀有包裹体中发现。这种对比凸显了一个根本性的差距：虽然天然样品在冲击条件下提供了硅酸盐钙钛矿的间接证据，但实验室动态压缩实验尚未直接捕获 MgSiO3 或 CaSiO3 中的钙钛矿转变，这可能是由于纳秒时间尺度施加的动力学限制。在这里，我们展示了动态压缩下 CaSiO3-钙钛矿形成的原位原子尺度观察。利用 SACLA 的纳秒激光驱动冲击和超快 X 射线衍射 (XRD)，我们追踪了 CaSiO3 从低压相到非晶态的转变，并最终转变为高于 ~91(10) GPa 的达维茂石，这表明了在纳秒时间尺度上实现重构结晶的无序-有序转变途径。释放后，davemaoite 通过短暂的低对称性相发生非晶化。这些观测结果为动态载荷下硅酸盐钙钛矿的形成提供了直接的结构证据，解决了长期存在的实验问题，并将动态压缩确立为探测与地球和富含钙的系外行星内部相关的深部地幔矿物的有效途径。

title: Automated transition state generation for mechanistic exploration in organic synthesis
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Accurate generation of intricate 3D molecular structures is a fundamental challenge in computational chemistry. Transition states (TS), the transient structures that dictate reaction kinetics, exemplify this challenge, as their calculation remains a major bottleneck in elucidating reaction mechanisms. While generative AI has shown promise in automating TS generation, existing methods are largely confined to simple systems, struggling with the complex structures like those in transition metal catalysis. Here we show a unified framework for general-purpose TS generation, comprising the UniTS-Lib library of 4,391 high-quality structures spanning 42 elements and diverse chemical transformations, coupled with the UniTS-Gen diffusion model that generates 3D TS configurations from 2D reactant graphs using a custom-designed higher-degree equivariant network. Validation demonstrates UniTS-Gen’s superior accuracy and robust generalization to unseen chemical systems. We show that UniTS-Gen provides reliable initial guesses and accelerates discovery by locating kinetically favored conformations. This work provides a scalable and transferable solution for automating mechanistic studies in organic synthesis and beyond.
title_zh: 用于有机合成机理探索的自动过渡态生成
abstract_zh: 准确生成复杂的 3D 分子结构是计算化学中的一项基本挑战。过渡态（TS）是决定反应动力学的瞬态结构，例证了这一挑战，因为它们的计算仍然是阐明反应机制的主要瓶颈。虽然生成式人工智能在自动化 TS 生成方面显示出了希望，但现有方法很大程度上局限于简单的系统，难以应对过渡金属催化等复杂结构。在这里，我们展示了通用 TS 生成的统一框架，包括包含 4,391 个跨越 42 个元素和不同化学转化的高质量结构的 UniTS-Lib 库，以及使用定制设计的更高阶等变网络从 2D 反应物图生成 3D TS 配置的 UniTS-Gen 扩散模型。验证表明 UniTS-Gen 对看不见的化学系统具有卓越的准确性和强大的泛化能力。我们表明，UniTS-Gen 提供了可靠的初始猜测，并通过定位动力学上有利的构象来加速发现。这项工作为有机合成及其他领域的自动化机理研究提供了一个可扩展和可转移的解决方案。

title: Reversed marine phosphorus gradient in the Ediacaran Ocean
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Ediacaran Period (635–539 Ma) witnessed the emergence of early animals, rapid oceanic oxygenation, and rising oceanic P availability. However, the relationships among these developments remain intensely debated. Here, we present high-resolution carbonate-associated phosphate (CAP) data from seven Ediacaran sections spanning diverse depositional environments across South China. Contrary to the modern ocean, our measurements reveal an inverted phosphorus (P) gradient, with lower P availability at depth. By integrating these data with a quantitative biogeochemical model, we show that increasing shallow-water P inputs drove enhanced productivity and bottom-water anoxia on continental shelves, while P-starved distal oceans became progressively oxygenated from the top downward, providing an oxygenated niche—a deep-ocean cradle—for early metazoan evolution. Our study establishes a conceptual framework linking nutrient dynamics, marine oxygenation, and evolutionary innovation in Earth’s early history.
title_zh: 埃迪卡拉海洋的海洋磷梯度逆转
abstract_zh: 埃迪卡拉纪（635-539Ma）见证了早期动物的出现、海洋快速氧化和海洋磷可用性的上升。然而，这些发展之间的关系仍然存在激烈争论。在这里，我们提供了来自华南不同沉积环境的七个埃迪卡拉纪剖面的高分辨率碳酸盐相关磷酸盐（CAP）数据。与现代海洋相反，我们的测量揭示了磷 (P) 梯度的倒转，深度处磷的利用率较低。通过将这些数据与定量生物地球化学模型相结合，我们表明，浅水磷输入的增加推动了大陆架生产力的提高和底层水缺氧，而缺乏磷的远端海洋从上到下逐渐氧化，为早期后生动物的进化提供了一个氧化生态位——深海摇篮。我们的研究建立了一个概念框架，将地球早期历史中的营养动态、海洋氧合和进化创新联系起来。

title: A nutrient control on oxygenation dynamics during Earth’s Great Oxidation Episode
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Earth’s first rise in atmospheric oxygen occurred over a protracted period from ca. 2.43 to 2.06 billion years ago during the Great Oxidation Episode (GOE). The GOE was marked by extreme climatic instability, which likely impacted the bioavailability of the principal limiting nutrient, phosphorus. Here, we investigate phosphorus cycling across the final two glaciations of the GOE, as documented by the Transvaal Supergroup, South Africa. Utilising a phosphorus phase partitioning approach, we show that following an enhanced weathering-induced phosphorus influx that stimulated oxygenation in the aftermath of glaciation, sedimentary phosphorus recycling was controlled by feedback-driven fluctuations in sulphate availability and oceanic redox state. Biogeochemical modelling suggests that this dynamic interplay drove major instability in atmospheric oxygen levels during Earth’s protracted transition to a persistently oxygenated atmosphere.
title_zh: 地球大氧化期间氧合动力学的营养控制
abstract_zh: 地球大气中氧气含量的首次上升发生在大约从大约 1000 年开始的一段较长时期内。 2.43 至 20.6 亿年前的大氧化期 (GOE)。 GOE 的特点是极端的气候不稳定，这可能影响了主要限制性营养素磷的生物利用度。在这里，我们研究了南非德兰士瓦超级集团记录的 GOE 最后两个冰川期的磷循环。利用磷相分配方法，我们表明，在冰川作用后，风化引起的磷流入增强，刺激了氧合，沉积物磷的循环受到硫酸盐有效性和海洋氧化还原状态的反馈驱动波动的控制。生物地球化学模型表明，在地球向持续含氧大气的长期过渡过程中，这种动态相互作用导致了大气含氧量的严重不稳定。

title: Sustained formation movement and destruction of coacervates in a waste-free system driven by electricity
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Transient compartmentalization and motion are fundamental to life, and milestones in the development of complex chemical systems. Coacervates have been proposed as compartments in this context, but efforts to drive them out-of-equilibrium use exergonic reactions, which are limited by waste accumulation. Here, we present a strategy for the transient formation and movement of coacervates, using an electric potential as energy source. In a two-electrode system, the oxidation of a cysteine-containing peptide increases its multivalency, leading to complexation and coacervate formation on the anode. The electrochemically-formed coacervates move by electrophoresis to the cathode, where they dissolve by electrocatalytic reduction. The system reaches a steady state in which coacervates are simultaneously forming, moving, and dissolving in different regions of the cell. Since no waste is generated, this out-of-equilibrium regime is sustained for long times without decaying. The combination of transient formation and movement with compartmentalization opens the door for electricity-driven active transport.
title_zh: 在电力驱动的无废物系统中持续形成运动并破坏凝聚层
abstract_zh: 瞬态分隔和运动是生命的基础，也是复杂化学系统发展的里程碑。在这种情况下，凝聚层被提议作为隔室，但驱使它们失去平衡的努力使用放能反应，而放能反应受到废物积累的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种使用电势作为能源来瞬时形成和运动凝聚层的策略。在双电极系统中，含半胱氨酸肽的氧化增加其多价性，导致阳极上络合和凝聚层形成。电化学形成的凝聚层通过电泳移动到阴极，并在阴极通过电催化还原而溶解。该系统达到稳定状态，其中凝聚层在细胞的不同区域同时形成、移动和溶解。由于不产生废物，这种不平衡状态可以长时间维持而不会衰减。瞬时形成和运动与分区的结合为电力驱动的主动运输打开了大门。

title: Precision high-speed quantum logic with holes on a natural silicon foundry platform
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Silicon spin qubits in gate-defined quantum dots leverage established semiconductor infrastructure and offer a scalable path toward transformative quantum technologies. Holes spins in silicon offer compact all-electrical control, whilst retaining the salient features of a quantum dot qubit architecture. However, silicon hole spin qubits are not as advanced as electrons, due to increased susceptibility to disorder and more complex spin physics. Here we demonstrate single-qubit gate fidelities up to 99.8% and a two-qubit gate quality factor of 240, indicating a physical fidelity limit of 99.7%. These results represent the highest performance reported in natural silicon to date, made possible by fast qubit control, exchange pulsing, and industrial-grade fabrication. Notably, we achieve these results in a near-identical device as used for highly reproducible, high-fidelity electron spin qubits. With isotopic purification and further device-level optimisations, silicon hole spin qubits are poised to unlock a new operation regime for quantum CMOS architectures.
title_zh: 天然硅铸造平台上的精密高速带孔量子逻辑
abstract_zh: 门定义量子点中的硅自旋量子位利用现有的半导体基础设施，并为变革性量子技术提供可扩展的路径。硅中的自旋孔提供紧凑的全电气控制，同时保留了量子点量子位架构的显着特征。然而，由于对无序性和更复杂的自旋物理的敏感性增加，硅空穴自旋量子位不如电子先进。在这里，我们展示了高达 99.8% 的单量子位门保真度和 240 的双量子位门品质因数，表明物理保真度极限为 99.7%。这些结果代表了迄今为止天然硅中报道的最高性能，这是通过快速量子位控制、交换脉冲和工业级制造实现的。值得注意的是，我们在与用于高度可重复、高保真电子自旋量子位的设备几乎相同的设备中实现了这些结果。通过同位素纯化和进一步的器件级优化，硅空穴自旋量子位有望为量子 CMOS 架构解锁新的操作机制。

title: Resolving root causes of experiment discrepancies guided by machine learning
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Scientists rely on accurate experimental data to explain nature and then harness this knowledge for applications addressing human needs. However, discrepancies between experiments of the same observable can impede scientific progress if one does not understand the underlying causes. Here, we developed a process that unravels data discrepancies by first using Bayesian machine learning to relate discrepancies to few of many, potentially biasing metadata features that encode experiment procedures. This machine learning output guides human experts to study discrepancy causes by simulating suspicious aspects of historical experiments or designing modern ones to address open questions. The study findings then lead to rejecting or correcting historical data on firm scientific bases. This process is demonstrated for the energy spectrum of neutrons emitted promptly (252Cf, a trusted nuclear physics Standard. It reduces the spread in experimental 252Cf spectra by up to a factor of 6.
title_zh: 通过机器学习解决实验差异的根本原因
abstract_zh: 科学家依靠准确的实验数据来解释自然，然后利用这些知识来满足人类需求。然而，如果不了解根本原因，同一可观察到的实验之间的差异可能会阻碍科学进步。在这里，我们开发了一个解决数据差异的过程，首先使用贝叶斯机器学习将差异与编码实验过程的许多潜在偏差元数据特征中的少数联系起来。该机器学习输出引导人类专家通过模拟历史实验的可疑方面或设计现代实验来解决悬而未决的问题来研究差异原因。然后，研究结果导致拒绝或纠正基于坚实科学基础的历史数据。这一过程在快速发射的中子能谱（252Cf，一种值得信赖的核物理标准）中得到了证明。它将实验 252Cf 谱中的扩散减少了多达 6 倍。

title: Probing magnetic correlations in space and time within predefined topological sectors of a macroscopic spin liquid
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The triangular Ising antiferromagnet, with its residual entropy density and critical correlations at absolute zero, is the archetype of a two-dimensional spin liquid. Its ground state is partitioned into topological sectors connected by global spin flip events that wrap the lattice boundaries, and become statistically irrelevant in the thermodynamic limit where magnetic fluctuations are restricted to the dominant sector. Thus far, these properties have been mainly investigated from a theoretical perspective, and one might wonder to what extent they can be transposed to real materials. Here, we present experimental observations obtained in an artificial, macroscopic realisation of the seminal triangular Ising antiferromagnet that consists of a lattice of millimeter-sized NdFeB cylinders put into motion by a mechanical shaker. Specifically, we demonstrate that the very-low-energy physics and the true ground state of this model can be reached experimentally. Besides, we are able to probe, in space and time, the magnetic properties within manually preselected pockets of the ground-state manifold that emulate, to a good approximation, the behaviour in distinct topological sectors. Our approach opens new avenues for naked-eye visualisation and hand manipulation of many-body phenomena associated to frustrated magnetism and models of statistical physics.
title_zh: 探测宏观自旋液体的预定义拓扑扇区内的空间和时间磁相关性
abstract_zh: 三角形伊辛反铁磁体的残余熵密度和临界相关性绝对为零，是二维自旋液体的原型。它的基态被划分为由包裹晶格边界的全局自旋翻转事件连接的拓扑扇区，并且在磁涨落仅限于主导扇区的热力学极限中变得统计上无关。到目前为止，这些特性主要是从理论角度进行研究的，人们可能想知道它们可以在多大程度上转化为真实材料。在这里，我们展示了在人工宏观实现的开创性三角形伊辛反铁磁体中获得的实验观察结果，该反铁磁体由毫米大小的 NdFeB 圆柱体晶格组成，通过机械振动器启动。具体来说，我们证明了可以通过实验达到该模型的极低能量物理和真实基态。此外，我们能够在空间和时间上探测基态流形的手动预选口袋内的磁性，这些口袋可以很好地近似模拟不同拓扑扇区的行为。我们的方法为肉眼可视化和手动操纵与受挫磁性和统计物理模型相关的多体现象开辟了新途径。

title: Carbonyl-staggered covalent organic frameworks for high-rate and stable rechargeable calcium-organic batteries
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Rechargeable calcium batteries are promising for next-generation energy storage devices due to the high crustal abundance of calcium (Ca) and the high-capacity and dendrite-free nature of Ca metal. However, their implementation is hindered by the lack of high-power and high-capacity positive electrodes, largely due to sluggish Ca2+ diffusion in inorganic hosts and limited active-site utilization in organic electrodes. Here we design a series of covalent organic frameworks incorporating different quinone units to construct carbonyl-staggered channels that accelerate Ca2+ hopping, enhance accessibility of deep-layer active sites even at high rates, and facilitate electronic charge transport through in situ conjugation reconstruction at ortho-carbonyl sites during repeated Ca2+ insertion. These combined effects contribute to fast charge-transfer kinetics, endowing the optimized heterogeneous framework with high-rate capability (56.4% capacity retention from 0.05 A g−1 to 2 A g−1) and long cyclability (71.7% capacity retention after 5,000 cycles at 2 A g−1), with further validation in Ca-metal pouch cells. This work highlights carbonyl staggering as a molecular design strategy for regulating Ca-ion transport and improving active-site utilization in calcium-organic batteries.
title_zh: 用于高倍率和稳定可充电钙有机电池的羰基交错共价有机框架
abstract_zh: 由于钙（Ca）的地壳丰度高以及Ca金属的高容量和无枝晶性质，可充电钙电池有望成为下一代储能设备。然而，它们的实施受到缺乏高功率和高容量正极的阻碍，这主要是由于无机主体中Ca2+扩散缓慢以及有机电极中活性位点利用有限。在这里，我们设计了一系列包含不同醌单元的共价有机框架，以构建羰基交错通道，加速Ca2+跳跃，即使在高速率下也能增强深层活性位点的可及性，并在重复Ca2+插入过程中通过邻位羰基位点的原位共轭重建促进电子电荷传输。这些综合效应有助于实现快速电荷转移动力学，赋予优化的异质框架高倍率性能（从 0.05 A g−1 到 2 A g−1 的容量保持率为 56.4%）和长循环能力（2 A g−1 下 5,000 次循环后容量保持率为 71.7%），并在钙金属软包电池中得到进一步验证。这项工作强调了羰基交错作为一种分子设计策略，用于调节钙离子传输和提高钙有机电池中活性位点的利用率。

title: Gating hole back-transfer with molecular spacers programs rapid micropollutant decontamination
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Precise control of oxygen activation to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) for on-demand micropollutant removal remains challenging. Herein, we develop a bottom-up molecular approach to systematically tailor dithienyl spacers (alkene/alkyl/benzene), from model fragments, amorphous polymers to high crystalline covalent-organic frameworks (COFs). We observe that the ordered assembly of benzene-bridged bithiophene units facilitates long-range electron transport, thereby suppressing the spatial recombination of photogenerated electron–hole pairs. These effects synergically reduce the oxygen adsorption barrier, efficiently generating superoxide radicals as the dominant ROS, with subsequent singlet-oxygen formation. Therefore, the removal of acetaminophen in water via the optimized Tapt-BDD COF catalyst achieves a reaction rate constant of 0.80 min−1. The degradation rates are enhanced by 63–95 fold over fragments (local repeating unit structure of the COF) and 5–8 fold over polymers (disordered COFs). Additionally, the proposed system demonstrates efficient retention in complex wastewater treatment scenarios, and under continuous operation. This work establishes a strategy of spacer-directed supermolecule preorganization for environmental catalysis.
title_zh: 带有分子间隔物的门孔反向传输程序可快速净化微污染物
abstract_zh: 精确控制氧气活化以产生活性氧 (ROS) 以按需去除微污染物仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们开发了一种自下而上的分子方法来系统地定制二噻吩基间隔基（烯烃/烷基/苯），从模型片段、无定形聚合物到高结晶共价有机框架（COF）。我们观察到苯桥联噻吩单元的有序组装促进了长程电子传输，从而抑制了光生电子空穴对的空间重组。这些效应协同降低氧吸附势垒，有效产生超氧自由基作为主要活性氧，随后形成单线态氧。因此，通过优化的 Tapt-BDD COF 催化剂去除水中的对乙酰氨基酚可实现 0.80 min−1 的反应速率常数。片段（COF 的局部重复单元结构）的降解率提高了 63-95 倍，聚合物（无序 COF）的降解率提高了 5-8 倍。此外，所提出的系统在复杂的废水处理场景和连续运行下表现出高效的保留能力。这项工作建立了一种用于环境催化的间隔基定向超分子预组织策略。

title: Towards density-optimal DNA storage with practical bijective coding
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: DNA storage is a promising solution to data explosion due to its high density and longevity. However, existing coding methods struggle to efficiently avoid error-prone sequences while retaining usable ones, leading to low density and high copy numbers. Here we show Siyuan Code, a DNA storage codec that achieves theoretically optimal density. Our method maps binary data to nearly all suitable low-error sequences in a one-to-one manner, using our data structure to catalog and avoid error-prone patterns. This allows operation under very strict biochemical constraints with minimal redundancy. Experiments demonstrate a storage density of 1.66 bits per nucleotide and a capacity of 41 exabytes per gram of DNA, with perfect data retrieval using only six copies per strand. Encoding and decoding speeds reach approximately 1 megabyte per second on commodity hardware, comparable to early USB flash drives. These results bring DNA storage closer to practical deployment.
title_zh: 通过实用的双射编码实现密度最优的 DNA 存储
abstract_zh: DNA 存储因其高密度和长寿命而成为解决数据爆炸的有前景的解决方案。然而，现有的编码方法很难有效地避免容易出错的序列，同时保留可用的序列，从而导致低密度和高拷贝数。在这里，我们展示了思源码，一种实现理论上最佳密度的 DNA 存储编解码器。我们的方法以一对一的方式将二进制数据映射到几乎所有合适的低错误序列，使用我们的数据结构来分类和避免容易出错的模式。这允许在非常严格的生化限制下以最小的冗余进行操作。实验证明，每个核苷酸的存储密度为 1.66 位，每克 DNA 的容量为 41 艾字节，每条链仅使用 6 个副本即可实现完美的数据检索。在商用硬件上，编码和解码速度约为每秒 1 兆字节，与早期的 USB 闪存驱动器相当。这些结果使 DNA 存储更接近实际部署。

title: Atomistic machine learning with irreducible Cartesian natural tensors
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Atomistic machine learning is a powerful tool for accurate and efficient investigation of material behavior at the atomic scale. While attempts have been made to construct models directly within Cartesian space, they face challenges in providing a systematic framework based on irreducible representations—a core feature of widely used spherical models. Here we propose Cartesian Natural Tensor Networks to overcome these limitations and thus offer a general, symmetry-preserving framework for atomistic machine learning. We present a theory of irreducible representations using Cartesian natural tensors, comprising their construction, their products, and a systematic scheme to decompose and reconstruct high-rank physical tensors. Leveraging this machinery, we develop equivariant machine learning interatomic potentials for materials and molecular systems with performance on par with leading spherical models. It further captures accurate structure–property relationships for tensorial quantities ranging from low-rank dipole moments to high-rank tensors with complex symmetries, such as the elastic constant tensor.
title_zh: 具有不可约笛卡尔自然张量的原子机器学习
abstract_zh: 原子机器学习是在原子尺度上准确有效地研究材料行为的强大工具。虽然已经尝试直接在笛卡尔空间内构建模型，但他们在提供基于不可约表示（广泛使用的球形模型的核心特征）的系统框架方面面临挑战。在这里，我们提出笛卡尔自然张量网络来克服这些限制，从而为原子机器学习提供一个通用的、保持对称的框架。我们提出了一种使用笛卡尔自然张量的不可约表示理论，包括它们的构造、它们的乘积，以及分解和重建高阶物理张量的系统方案。利用这种机器，我们为材料和分子系统开发了等变机器学习原子间势，其性能与领先的球形模型相当。它进一步捕获了从低阶偶极矩到具有复杂对称性的高阶张量（例如弹性常数张量）的张量的准确结构-性质关系。

title: Umbrella-type stretchable electrode arrays for long-term neural recording
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Flexible implantable neural electrodes have been studied extensively due to their chronic single-unit recording capability over weeks or months. However, high-density stable recording of the same neuronal ensembles over years-long periods remains challenging. Here we address this challenge by developing umbrella-type stretchable electrode arrays, which are anchored to surrounding brain tissue, forming a seamless neuroelectronic interface. We show that the umbrella-type stretchable electrode arrays create a neuroelectronic interface with reduced probe drift and gliosis that can stably track the same neuronal ensembles in head-fixed mice over 80 weeks (approximately 1.5 years). We also demonstrate that orientation-selective neuronal populations in the mouse primary visual cortex can be consistently recorded over 20 weeks. The umbrella-type stretchable electrode arrays with long-term recording capabilities hold significant promise for both fundamental neuroscience research and clinical brain-machine interface systems.
title_zh: 用于长期神经记录的伞型可拉伸电极阵列
abstract_zh: 柔性植入式神经电极因其具有数周或数月的长期单单元记录能力而受到广泛研究。然而，在长达数年的时间里对相同神经元群进行高密度稳定记录仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过开发伞型可拉伸电极阵列来应对这一挑战，该电极阵列固定在周围的脑组织上，形成无缝的神经电子接口。我们证明，伞型可拉伸电极阵列创建了一个神经电子接口，减少了探针漂移和神经胶质增生，可以在 80 周（约 1.5 年）内稳定地跟踪头部固定小鼠中的相同神经元群。我们还证明，可以在 20 周内持续记录小鼠初级视觉皮层中的方向选择性神经元群。具有长期记录能力的伞型可拉伸电极阵列为基础神经科学研究和临床脑机接口系统带来了巨大的希望。

title: Regulated liquid metal via semiconductor valve toward highly stretchable topological circuits
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Wearable electronics with complex circuits and three-dimensional (3D) structure are indispensable to advanced next-generation flexible technologies like e-skins and soft robotics. However, fabricating 3D flexible electronics remains challenging, primarily due to the difficulty in obtaining highly stretchable materials with precise current control and complex topological structures. This work reports a unidirectional conductive semiconductor valve in liquid metals (LM-SV) constructed via interfacial barrier engineering to enable soft, complex topological circuits. The LM-SV exhibits ultrahigh stretchability (~1000% strain), robust unidirectional conductivity over 1000 cycles at 500% strain, and stable operation across wide temperature ( − 5–100 °C) and frequency (1 Hz – 5 MHz) ranges. Switching voltages (0.43—0.80 V) are conveniently tunable through LM composition modulation. Leveraging these features, LM-SV circuits can be topologically reconfigured from 2D layouts into 3D architectures with real-time functional switching. Furthermore, a wirelessly powered stretchable logic circuit demonstrates the potential of this LM-SV strategy for advanced flexible electronic systems.
title_zh: 通过半导体阀调节液态金属以实现高度可拉伸的拓扑电路
abstract_zh: 具有复杂电路和三维 (3D) 结构的可穿戴电子产品对于电子皮肤和软机器人等先进的下一代柔性技术不可或缺。然而，制造 3D 柔性电子产品仍然具有挑战性，主要是因为难以获得具有精确电流控制和复杂拓扑结构的高可拉伸材料。这项工作报告了一种通过界面势垒工程构建的液态金属单向导电半导体阀（LM-SV），以实现柔软、复杂的拓扑电路。 LM-SV 具有超高的拉伸性（~1000% 应变）、在 500% 应变下超过 1000 个循环的强大单向导电性，以及在宽温度 (− 5–100 °C) 和频率 (1 Hz – 5 MHz) 范围内稳定运行。开关电压 (0.43—0.80 V) 可通过 LM 复合调制方便地调节。利用这些功能，LM-SV 电路可以从 2D 布局拓扑重新配置为具有实时功能切换的 3D 架构。此外，无线供电的可拉伸逻辑电路展示了这种 LM-SV 策略在先进柔性电子系统中的潜力。

title: Iceland-Faroe overflow revealed by in-situ observations
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Overflow across the Iceland-Faroe Ridge is an important contributor to the deep limb of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation. Despite decades of observations, the strength, stability, and exact pathways of the overflow have remained uncertain. Here, we present results from several dedicated year-long current observations along the ~300 km long ridge crest. These observations reveal strong overflow at the central parts of the ridge with smaller contributions across both ends. The observations support the hypothesis that overflow is inhibited at both ends by upper-layer inflow of Atlantic water to the Norwegian Sea. In contrast, retroflection of Atlantic inflow over the central parts, allows the overflow to cross the ridge there, apparently as pulsating flow along two main pathways. The available data do not allow accurate estimates of volume transport, but they indicate that these pathways may well supply overflow in amounts consistent with previously published estimates.
title_zh: 现场观测揭示冰岛-法罗群岛溢流
abstract_zh: 跨越冰岛-法罗海脊的溢流是大西洋经向翻转环流深缘的重要贡献者。尽管经过数十年的观察，溢出的强度、稳定性和确切路径仍然不确定。在这里，我们展示了沿约 300 公里长的山脊顶部进行的数项长达一年的专门水流观测结果。这些观察结果表明，山脊中部的溢出量很大，两端的溢出量较小。这些观测结果支持这样的假设：大西洋上层海水流入挪威海，两端的​​溢流受到抑制。相比之下，大西洋流入流经过中心部分的逆反射，使得溢流能够穿过那里的山脊，显然是沿着两条主要路径的脉动流。现有数据无法准确估计体积运输，但它们表明这些路径很可能提供与先前发布的估计一致的溢出量。

title: 3D printed designer color routers with low refractive index for low-light imaging
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Color imaging systems that underpin modern technologies still suffer in low-light conditions because of the inherently lossy filtering mechanism of conventional Bayer color filters. Although Bayer-type filters integrated with complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor sensors remain the dominant architecture, they typically transmit only about 30% of incident white light, leading to noisy images under weak illumination. Color routers offer an alternative by redirecting different spectral components of light to corresponding photodiodes in the near field. While recent color routers based on high-refractive-index metasurfaces have shown promise, low-refractive-index materials remain largely unexplored despite their potential for higher transmittance and cost-effective mass production. Here, we demonstrate inverse-designed, two-photon-polymerization 3D-printed pixel-level color routers using low-index IP-L resin (n ≈ 1.5). The color routers achieve transmittance of ~87% in simulation and ~70% experimentally across the visible spectrum. Monochrome-sensor imaging further confirms improved color fidelity and shorter exposure times, highlighting their potential for next-generation high-efficiency imaging platforms.
title_zh: 3D 打印设计师彩色路由器，具有低折射率，适用于低光成像
abstract_zh: 由于传统拜耳滤色镜固有的有损滤光机制，支撑现代技术的彩色成像系统在低光条件下仍然会受到影响。尽管与互补金属氧化物半导体传感器集成的拜耳型滤光片仍然是主导架构，但它们通常仅传输约 30% 的入射白光，导致弱照明下图像出现噪声。彩色路由器提供了一种替代方案，将光的不同光谱分量重定向到近场中相应的光电二极管。虽然最近基于高折射率超表面的彩色路由器已显示出前景，但低折射率材料尽管具有更高的透射率和具有成本效益的大规模生产潜力，但在很大程度上仍未得到开发。在这里，我们展示了使用低折射率 IP-L 树脂 (n ≈ 1.5) 的逆向设计、双光子聚合 3D 打印像素级彩色路由器。彩色路由器在可见光谱范围内的模拟透射率约为 87%，实验透射率约为 70%。单色传感器成像进一步证实了色彩保真度的提高和曝光时间的缩短，凸显了它们作为下一代高效成像平台的潜力。

title: Long-range two-dimensional exciton sensitization of triplet-pair emission
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The spin-entangled triplet-pair state produced by singlet fission is promising for quantum information applications, but its optical darkness severely limits spectroscopic access and optical readout. Here we show that monolayer WS2 can act as a long-range excitonic sensitizer for triplet-pair emission in the singlet-fission molecule 6,13-bis(triisopropylsilylethynyl)-tetramethyl pentacene (TCPS). Strong excitonic resonances and spin–orbit–split valleys in WS2 mediate long-range excitonic energy transfer into the triplet-pair manifold, enhancing triplet-pair emission by more than two orders of magnitude. This enhancement arises from the exceptionally large exciton transition dipole moment of WS2, which enables efficient dipole–dipole coupling across the hybrid interface. Temperature-dependent and time-resolved spectroscopy reveals ultrafast picosecond energy transfer. Distance-dependent measurements demonstrate efficient transfer beyond 100 nm, inconsistent with classical Förster scaling and instead indicative of radiative, near-field–assisted coupling with a shallow ~ 1/d dependence. These results establish a mechanism for long-range triplet-pair sensitization in hybrid molecular/transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures and provide a route for coupling correlated multiexciton states to optically active excitonic materials.
title_zh: 三重态对发射的长程二维激子敏化
abstract_zh: 单线态裂变产生的自旋纠缠三重态对态在量子信息应用中很有前景，但其光学暗度严重限制了光谱获取和光学读出。在这里，我们证明单层 WS2 可以作为单重态裂变分子 6,13-​​双（三异丙基甲硅烷基乙炔基）-四甲基并五苯（TCPS）中三重态对发射的长程激子敏化剂。 WS2 中的强激子共振和自旋轨道分裂谷介导长程激子能量转移到三重态对流形中，从而将三重态对发射增强两个数量级以上。这种增强源于 WS2 的异常大的激子跃迁偶极矩，这使得能够在混合界面上实现有效的偶极-偶极耦合。温度依赖性和时间分辨光谱揭示了超快皮秒能量转移。与距离相关的测量表明，在 100 nm 范围内的有效传输与经典的福斯特标度不一致，而是表明辐射、近场辅助耦合具有浅的 ~ 1/d 依赖性。这些结果建立了杂化分子/过渡金属二硫族化物异质结构中的长程三重态对敏化机制，并提供了将相关多激子态耦合到光学活性激子材料的途径。

title: Tough, thermal insulating and scalable puff pastry-inspired architected cementitious material via simple rolling-folding
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Architected material design enables cementitious materials to achieve highly desirable mechanical and functional performance for next-generation infrastructure. However, current architected cementitious materials require complex and energy-intensive fabrication, limiting their scalability and large-scale implementation. Inspired by the preparation of puff pastry, we propose a lamellar cementitious architected material fabricated by a simple rolling-folding process under ambient conditions. This material features a highly ordered lamellar architecture, consisting of alternating parallel cement lamellae and discrete plate-like cavities. This structure enables ductile fracture behavior, high fracture toughness, and effective thermal insulation. The specific fracture toughness of this material reaches up to 91 MPa·mm0.5/g·cm3, approximately 20 times higher than that of the cast counterpart, surpassing conventional reinforced cementitious composites and approaching the level of certain polymers. Meanwhile, its thermal conductivity decreases to 0.38 W/m·K, representing a 68.3% reduction relative to the cast counterpart, and outperforming lightweight cementitious materials with comparable densities. Furthermore, this material demonstrates good manufacturing efficiency, scalability, and geometric adaptability, overcoming the application limitations of existing architected cementitious materials. This study can help advance the development of next-generation infrastructure materials.
title_zh: 坚韧、隔热且可扩展的受酥皮启发的建筑水泥材料，通过简单的滚动折叠
abstract_zh: 建筑材料设计使水泥材料能够实现下一代基础设施非常理想的机械和功能性能。然而，当前设计的水泥材料需要复杂且能源密集型的制造，限制了其可扩展性和大规模实施。受酥皮糕点制备的启发，我们提出了一种在环境条件下通过简单的滚压折叠工艺制造的层状水泥建筑材料。这种材料具有高度有序的层状结构，由交替的平行水泥层和离散的板状空腔组成。这种结构具有延性断裂行为、高断裂韧性和有效的隔热性能。该材料的比断裂韧度高达91 MPa·mm0.5/g·cm3，比铸造材料高约20倍，超过了传统的增强水泥基复合材料，接近某些聚合物的水平。同时，其导热系数降低至0.38 W/m·K，相对于铸造材料降低了68.3%，优于同等密度的轻质水泥材料。此外，该材料表现出良好的制造效率、可扩展性和几何适应性，克服了现有建筑水泥材料的应用限制。这项研究有助于推进下一代基础设施材料的开发。

abstract:

title: Enabling Fast Charging of Lithium‐Ion Batteries With Regioisomeric Nitrile Additives for Interphase Regulation
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Achieving fast charging across a wide range of operating conditions remains challenging for lithium (Li)‐ion batteries due to unstable electrode–electrolyte interphases (EEIs) and sluggish interfacial kinetics. Here, we introduce a nitrile‐based additive strategy to regulate interphase formation, while maintaining full compatibility with the commercial LP57 electrolyte, thereby avoiding the need for expensive salts or complex electrolyte reformulation. By incorporating only 0.5 wt.% of 3‐(trifluoromethyl) benzonitrile (AD3), the modified electrolyte significantly enhances fast‐charging performance in 1 Ah Graphite (Gr) | LiNi

                    pouch cells, while also improving low‐temperature, high‐temperature, and high‐voltage stabilities. Mechanistic analysis reveals that AD3 fundamentally alters the interphase formation at both electrodes. At the cathode, AD3 suppresses penetration of decomposition products and enables the formation of a thinner, more uniform cathode‐electrolyte interphase. At the anode, its preferential reduction leads to a thin (10 nm), well‐controlled solid‐electrolyte interphase (SEI) and effectively suppresses Li plating, in contrast to a thick (450 nm), Li‐rich layer formed in LP57. title: Tunable Stimuli‐Responsive Luminescence From Covalent Organic Frameworks Displaying Vibration‐Induced Emission
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Introducing dynamic components that couple molecular motion with optical output offers a promising strategy for developing stimuli‐responsive luminescent covalent organic frameworks (COFs). Vibration‐induced emission (VIE) molecules are particularly attractive dynamic luminophores, as their excited‐state bent‐to‐planar conformational evolution enables dual emission, large Stokes shifts, and environment‐regulated fluorescence. However, VIE‐based COFs have not yet been reported. Herein, we report two VIE‐based three‐dimensional COFs, JUC‐735 and JUC‐736, constructed from a symmetric N,N’‐diphenyl‐dihydrodibenzo[a,c]phenazine (DPAC)‐derived building block with a saddle‐shaped conformation. Both COFs exhibit high crystallinity, thermal stability, and well‐defined porosity. Photophysical studies reveal that the excited‐state conformational evolution of DPAC remains operative in these crystalline environments, leading to dual emission with exceptionally large Stokes shifts in solution (> 300 nm; 14526 cm
                    −
                    1
                    for JUC‐735 and 14272 cm
                    −
                    1
                    for JUC‐736). This dynamic emission behavior further enables tunable luminescence responses to aggregation, viscosity, and pressure. Notably, JUC‐736 shows more pronounced dual‐emission modulation under aggregation, near‐white‐light emission tuning, and reversible multicolor piezofluorochromism, whereas JUC‐735 mainly exhibits long‐wavelength emission modulation with higher intensity sensitivity. These results highlight the important role of the local framework environment in regulating the stimuli‐responsive emission behavior of dynamic chromophores, providing a working strategy for designing multi‐stimuli‐responsive luminescent COF materials.

title: C─S Bond Formation of Aryl Germanes
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Aryl germanes have emerged as robust and orthogonal coupling partners, but the chemistry enabling their functionalization is still in its infancy. Herein, we report the first C─S bond formation of aryl germanes. In contrast to conventional C─S cross‐couplings of prefunctionalized arenes that largely rely on transition‐metal catalysis, this transformation proceeds in the absence of a metal catalyst at room temperature and tolerates air and moisture. The reaction is orthogonal to common coupling handles, including aryl halides and aryl silanes, enabling selective thiolations in multifunctional molecules. Mechanistic studies support a radical‐based aromatic substitution pathway.

title: Graphene as a Synthetic Platform for Post‐Graphene 2D Materials and Heterostructures
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Graphene's pioneering role as the first isolated and systematically studied 2D material has fueled intense research into its synthesis and applications, while simultaneously accelerating the discovery and development of numerous other 2D materials. Recent progress in synthesizing high‐quality graphene, especially through the chemical vapor deposition (CVD) method, has been particularly significant, solidifying its position as a critical platform for propelling research across the entire field of 2D materials. This review summarizes the applications of high‐quality graphene single crystals and films in synthesizing and engineering other 2D materials—including conventional inorganic and emerging organic 2D materials. We focus specifically on graphene's functions as a growth substrate and epitaxial template for optimizing the preparation of post‐graphene 2D materials, and on its use in constructing heterostructures that broaden application prospects and enhance device performance. We further examine current challenges and future research directions, aiming to leverage high‐quality graphene to achieve facile synthesis of post‐graphene 2D materials and their heterostructures with precise control over composition, orientation, and interfacial interactions. Such advances are anticipated to enable high‐performance devices in next‐generation electronics, optoelectronics, sensors, catalysts, spintronics, and beyond.

title: Accelerating Intramolecular Nonradiative Decay via GSH‐Triggered Reassembly of Semiconducting Polymer Nanoprobes for Activatable NIR‐II Phototheranostics
source: Wiley: Angewandte Chemie International Edition: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    The development of activatable near‐infrared‐II (NIR‐II) photoacoustic and photothermal probes is of great significance for advancing precision phototheranostics toward deep‐seated diseases. Despite our preliminary success in enabling semiconducting polymer nanoprobes (SPNs)‐based activatable NIR‐II photoacoustic imaging (PAI) and photothermal therapy (PTT), this design strategy still requires complicated and time‐consuming chemical syntheses to incorporate activatable groups into the hydrophobic semiconducting backbone, leading to their encapsulation within the nanoprobe core and consequently compromise the responsiveness toward pathological factors in biological environment. Herein, we report a novel activatable SPN (SPN
                    0
                    ) that enables glutathione (GSH)‐triggered size transition for amplified NIR‐II PAI and PTT. The SPN
                    0
                    was prepared by nanoprecipitation of a diketopyrrolopyrrole‐thiadiazoloquinoxaline semiconducting polymer with a GSH‐responsive amphiphilic matrix. Upon GSH activation, the SPN
                    0
                    undergoes a reassembly process to increase the nanoparticle size. Excited‐state dynamics investigations reveal that GSH‐triggered reassembly accelerates intramolecular nonradiative decay in the nanoprobes, which contributes to the enhanced NIR‐II photoacoustic and photothermal performance. In vitro and in vivo studies demonstrate GSH‐activated NIR‐II PAI and PTT toward cancer with high specificity and biosafety. This reassembly strategy provides a convenient and efficient approach to construct activatable NIR‐II phototheranostic nano‐agents, advancing the development of precision medicine.
